### [209] [Code Smells in Clojure: Initial Findings from a Grey Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24049)
*Walber Araújo,José Truta,Lucas Vegi,Marco Tulio Valente,João Brunet*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是对 Vegi & Valente 面向 Elixir 的「代码坏味道灰文献综述」研究在 Clojure 生态中的复现性初步研究。作者通过 Google 搜索抓取并人工筛选 60 篇结果中的 15 篇开发者讨论文档，提取出 26 个代码坏味道（12 个 Clojure 专属、9 个函数式风格、5 个 Fowler 传统坏味道），并邀请 44 位 Clojure 从业者对候选坏味道的相关性进行问卷评估；工具支持分析表明 clj-kondo、Eastwood、Joker、Kibit 等现有 Clojure 静态分析工具仅覆盖其中 2 个（:not-empty?、:redundant-do），另有 1 个部分覆盖（:not-nil? 对应 Verbose Checks），存在明显工具支持缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码坏味道（code smells）是衡量代码质量、提示结构性缺陷与重构机会的重要概念，但学界研究长期集中于面向对象语言；函数式编程语言的研究相对匮乏。已有 Elixir 生态的工作（Vegi & Valente，2022/2023/2025）证明开发者会同时讨论传统坏味道与语言特有质量问题，作者亦被明确建议将该研究扩展到 Clojure 等现代函数式语言。Clojure 作为运行于 JVM 的现代 Lisp 方言，在 Apple、Nubank、Netflix、Spotify、Walmart 等工业系统中被广泛采用，并具备与 Java 良好的互操作性，但其在软件质量与坏味道方面的实证研究十分有限。因此本文希望回答：Clojure 开发者是否讨论传统坏味道（RQ1）？是否讨论其他坏味道（RQ2）？知名静态分析工具能否检测这些坏味道（RQ3）？由于仅依赖单一灰文献来源，作者明确声明目标不是给出经验证的目录，而是报告初步证据。

Method: 研究在 Elixir 灰文献综述基线之上做复现并加以扩展。(1) 检索：2025 年 2 月 13 日人工使用保持原结构、仅替换语言名的 Google 查询（"Clojure" + code smell/bad smell/anti-pattern/bad practice 等同义词），约 17.3 万条结果，按惯例筛选前 60 条；(2) 选择：前两位作者独立筛出 15 篇讨论 Clojure 非惯用/质量问题的文档，末 10 条结果无相关文档；(3) 提取与校验：两位作者独立提取坏味道证据后对比协商（仅 2 处冲突，保留 Unnecessary Macros，剔除文档 G8）；(4) 社区互动：2025 年 7—9 月通过 Slack、Discord、Google Groups、Reddit 及 GitHub 仓库 issue 宣传并收集反馈，成员普遍认为传统坏味道适用性低，据此在问卷中剔除传统坏味道；(5) 从业者问卷：44 份有效回复、214 条可选评论，对每个候选坏味道可选 Yes/No/I don't know 并附评论；(6) 工具支持评估：分析 clj-kondo、Eastwood、Joker、Kibit 的官方文档与诊断规则，将已支持检查映射到所提取的坏味道。

Result: RQ1：存在传统坏味道的讨论证据，但未必使用 Fowler 术语，而是以特征描述；其中仅 Long Parameter List 出现在多篇文档（G1、G2），其余 Long Method、Shotgun Surgery、Inappropriate Intimacy、Comments 各仅 1 篇。社区反馈认为这些传统坏味道在 Clojure 中大多不适用、可整节删除。RQ2：提取出 12 个 Clojure 专属坏味道（Unnecessary Macros、Namespaced Keys Neglect、Improper Emptiness Check、Accessing non-existent Map Fields、Unnecessary into、Conditional Build-Up、Verbose Checks、Production doall、Redundant do Block、Thread Ignorance、Nested Forms、Direct Usage of clojure.lang.RT）与 9 个函数式风格坏味道（Trivial Lambda、Inefficient Filtering、Overabstracted Composition、Deeply-nested Call Stacks、Overuse of Higher-Order Functions、Lazy Side Effects、Hidden Side Effects、Explicit Recursion、Positional Return Values）。问卷相关性最高者为 Unnecessary Macros 88.37%、Lazy Side Effects 90.48%、Hidden Side Effects 78.57%、Thread Ignorance 与 Nested Forms 各 76.74%、Verbose Checks 与 Explicit Recursion 各 71.43%；Deeply-nested Call Stacks 最低（48.78%）。RQ3：现有工具仅直接覆盖 26 个坏味道中的 2 个——Improper Emptiness Check（clj-kondo :not-empty?）与 Redundant do Block（:redundant-do），Verbose Checks 获 :not-nil? 部分支持，其余均不被支持，说明现有 linter 主要覆盖局部语法与风格问题。

Conclusion: 本文给出了 Clojure 生态代码坏味道的初步刻画：开发者确实以自己的语言讨论传统坏味道，但社区普遍认为其适用性弱；真正有社区共识的是 12 个 Clojure 专属与 9 个函数式风格坏味道；自动化支持存在显著缺口——绝大多数结构性/设计层面坏味道无诊断规则。研究定位为早期（preliminary）证据，威胁包括检索式构造效度、灰文献结论效度（个人偏好偏差）、单一来源导致的内外部效度局限。作者未来工作：挖掘 GitHub 上 Clojure 开源仓库（源码、提交、issue、PR）以三角验证并发现新候选；开发针对该目录的定制静态分析规则并向 clj-kondo 贡献规则；研究移除坏味道的最佳实践并提出配套的重构策略目录。

Abstract: Code smells are widely used indicators of poor code quality, revealing structural problems and areas where improvement can be made. Although extensively studied in object-oriented languages, functional programming languages remain comparatively underexplored in literature. This paper presents early results from a grey literature investigation of code smells in Clojure, a modern functional programming language that runs on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) and is widely adopted in open source and industrial systems. Inspired by prior work on Elixir, we manually inspected developer discussions retrieved through Google search, extracted quality concerns discussed by developers, and had 44 practitioners evaluate the relevance of non-traditional smell candidates. As preliminary results, we cataloged 26 code smells, including 12 Clojure-specific, 9 functional-style, and 5 traditional Fowler smells. We also analyzed tool support and observed a significant gap, as existing Clojure linters cover only 2 of these 26 smells. These early findings provide an initial characterization of how Clojure developers discuss code smells, a preliminary set of smell-like problems specific to this ecosystem, and an early assessment of tool support for their detection.

</details>


### [210] [More Skills, Worse Agents? Skill Shadowing Degrades Performance When Expanding Skill Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24050)
*Hongwen Song,Song,Wei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM agent技能库扩展时的性能退化问题，将退化分解为skill shadowing（错误技能选择增加）和context overhead（上下文增大影响执行）两个效应。研究发现skill shadowing是主要瓶颈，而非上下文增大，这为未来技能库设计提供了明确方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM agent技能库规模增长，性能显著下降（从小型有帮助技能集扩展到202技能库时下降达21%），亟需理解这一性能退化的根本原因。

Method: 通过条件分解技能调用（agent在轨迹中选择的技能），将pass rate drop分解为两个效应：skill shadowing（库扩展时错误选择技能的概率增加）和context overhead（选择正确时上下文增大导致执行降级）。同时推导了两个效应的上界以量化其影响程度。

Result: 实证估计和理论上界均表明：skill shadowing效应随库规模增长而增大，是pass rate下降的主要原因；而context overhead效应很小，接近于零。

Conclusion: Skill shadowing（而非上下文开销）是扩展技能库时的主要性能瓶颈。这一发现表明，提升技能选择能力而非优化上下文长度或减少上下文干扰，应成为未来研究的首要方向。

Abstract: Skill libraries allow LLM agents to load task-specific instructions on demand, letting non-expert users solve domain-specific tasks through natural language without knowing which skills exist or how they work. However, performance degrades as libraries grow -- by up to 21\% when scaling from a small set of helpful skills to a 202-skill library. In this work, we formulate this performance degradation as the pass rate drop between loading a library of known-helpful skills and the full library. Moreover, we propose to decompose the pass rate drop by conditioning on the skill(s) invocation -- which skills the agent selects during a trajectory -- into two effects: \emph{skill shadowing}, where the agent selects wrong skills more often as the library expands, and \emph{context overhead}, where the enlarged context degrades execution even when selection is correct. We derive upper bounds on both effects to characterize their magnitudes of impacts to the pass rate drop. Our empirical estimates of the effects and their upper bounds both show that the \emph{skill shadowing} effect grows with library size and significantly contributes to the performance degradation, whereas the \emph{context overhead} effect remains small and indistinguishable from zero. This observed asymmetry establishes that the skill selection failure, not the enlarged context, is the primary bottleneck when expanding the skill libraries.

</details>


### [211] [TRACER: A Semantic-Aware Framework for Fine-Grained Contamination Detection in Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24079)
*Yifeng Di,Xuliang Huang,Tianyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TRACER提出首个细粒度代码污染检测框架，通过功能等价、近似等价和共享逻辑三层语义重叠建模实现代码LLM污染检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Data contamination threatens model evaluation reliability in code LLMs, where contamination extends beyond exact duplication.

Method: TRACER: semantic-aware framework using three-level semantic overlap modeling (Functionally Identical, Nearly Identical, Shared Logic) and coarse-to-fine detection pipeline.

Result: GPT-5 achieves F1 of 0.91 in fine-grained detection; binary setting achieves F1 of 0.92, outperforming existing methods by 42%-217%.

Conclusion: First fine-grained code contamination benchmark spanning three widely used benchmarks and three post-training datasets; ablation studies and error analysis confirm component contributions.

Abstract: Data contamination is a known threat to the reliability of model evaluation. However, it remains underexplored in code large language models (LLMs), where contamination often goes beyond exact duplication. We present TRACER, a semantic-aware framework for fine-grained code contamination detection. TRACER models contamination using three levels of semantic overlap - Functionally Identical, Nearly Identical, and Shared Logic - and detects them through a coarse-to-fine pipeline. We also introduce the first benchmark for fine-grained code contamination detection, spanning three widely used benchmarks and three representative post-training datasets. TRACER achieves strong and consistent performance across multiple LLM backbones, with GPT-5 reaching an F1 score of 0.91 in fine-grained detection. In the binary setting, TRACER attains an F1 of 0.92, outperforming existing methods by 42%-217%. We further conduct ablation studies and error analysis to assess the contributions of individual components in TRACER.

</details>


### [212] [Empirical Analysis and Detection of Hallucinations in LLM-Generated Bug Report Summaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24137)
*Hinduja Nirujan,Shreyas Patil,Abdallah Ayoub,Ahmad Abdel Latif,Gouri Ginde*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM生成的bug报告摘要中的幻觉问题，提出一种section-aware幻觉检测方法，通过合成幻觉注入构建benchmark，联合完成幻觉存在检测、部分识别和类型分类三项任务，在BugsRepo数据集上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的bug报告摘要常产生幻觉（包括缺失信息和虚构内容），但现有幻觉检测方法仅在完整响应层面评估，未考虑技术文档的结构化特性。初步探索性研究发现80份结构化bug报告摘要中约47.9%包含缺失信息，12.3%包含虚构内容，亟需系统性的幻觉分析。

Method: 基于BugsRepo数据集（来自Mozilla开源项目），采用受控的合成幻觉注入方法构建基准数据集。提出section-aware幻觉检测方法，联合预测报告是否包含幻觉内容、识别受影响的部分，并对幻觉类型进行分类。实验在多个预训练语言模型上进行评估。

Result: 最佳模型在所有任务上均取得优异表现：报告级Macro-F1达0.89，部分级Macro-F1达0.83，幻觉类型Macro-F1达0.84。

Conclusion: 研究强调了section-aware幻觉分析对提升LLM辅助bug报告摘要可靠性的重要性，为软件维护工作流提供了更可靠的自动化工具基础。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate summaries of software bug reports, including sections such as Steps-to-Reproduce (S2R), Actual Behavior (AB), and Expected Behavior (EB). However, these models frequently produce hallucinations that can be convincing but unsupported by the source report. This can mislead developers and reduce trust in automated maintenance tools. Existing hallucination detection approaches typically evaluate outputs at the full-response level and do not consider the structure of technical documents. An initial exploratory study on 80 structured bug report summaries found that approximately 47.9% contained missing information, while 12.3% included fabricated content, highlighting the need for systematic hallucination analysis in bug report summarization. In this work, we empirically investigate hallucinations in LLM-generated bug report summaries from a section-aware perspective. Using the BugsRepo dataset, derived from Mozilla OSS projects, we introduce controlled synthetic hallucination injection to construct a benchmark for training and evaluation. We propose a section-aware hallucination detection approach that jointly predicts whether a summary contains hallucinated content, identifies affected sections, and classifies hallucination types. Experimental results across multiple pretrained language models show that the proposed approach achieves strong performance across all tasks, with the best model obtaining 0.89 report-level Macro-F1, 0.83 section-level Macro-F1, and 0.84 hallucination-type Macro-F1. We further analyze common hallucination patterns and model failure modes to better understand limitations of current LLM-generated bug report summaries. The findings highlight the importance of section-aware hallucination analysis for improving the reliability of LLM-assisted bug report summarization in software maintenance workflows.

</details>


### [213] [Understanding Conversational Patterns in Multi-agent Programming: A Case Study on Fibonacci Game Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24138)
*Srijita Basu,Viktor Kjellberg,Simin Sun,Bengt Haraldsson,Md. Abu Ahammed Babu,Wilhelm Meding,Farnaz Fotrousi,Miroslaw Staron*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以"用 C 语言编写一个 Fibonacci 数学游戏"为单一用例，系统分析了由 7 个开源 LLM（Gemma 2/3、LLaMA 3.2/3.3、DeepSeek-R1、MiniCPM、Qwen3）构成的 12 种 Designer:Programmer 智能体配对的对话轨迹，从"效率（收敛速度与稳定性）、一致性（BLEU/ROUGE 角色对齐）、有效性（编译成功率）"三个维度刻画多智能体协作动态。核心发现：三个维度相互解耦——DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 是唯一从第一轮即产出正确解并保持到最后、但语义高度回声且编译成功率仅 3.29% 的组合；Qwen3:Qwen3 与 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 角色对齐强、编译成功率 100%，却从未得到正确解；其余配对则偏离任务、无法收敛。研究主张以重复率、主题黏附度、角色稳定性等交互轨迹信号定义停止条件与健康监控机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 已广泛用于软件工程（Copilot、ChatGPT、CodeWhisperer 在 HumanEval/MBPP 等基准上表现良好），多智能体 LLM 系统被认为可通过角色分工与协作处理复杂 SE 任务。但现有评测多聚焦于短小、自封闭的任务，缺少对智能体在长程交互中如何保持任务焦点、维持角色一致性、协调收敛的实证理解。已有研究表明无约束的智能体交互会系统性失败：错误传播、对错误解的过早共识、无法收敛的分歧，即使早期已出现正确的部分解。因此"简单允许智能体交互"并不足以构建可靠的自主 SE 系统，需要先刻画交互动态本身。研究动机并非评测任务难度或基准性能，而是理解角色化 LLM 智能体在迭代编程中的对话模式、角色遵循、行为漂移与交互停滞。

Method: 采用轻量可控的智能体框架：中央 Controller（Python 脚本）负责确定性轮次切换、消息路由、终止条件与日志；Programmer（仅输出 C 代码，无注释解释）与 Designer（给出设计建议、重构指导）各以固定系统提示一次性初始化，通过累积消息历史维持角色条件。参数：temperature=0.5（0.3–1.0 预实验选定以减少重复与幻觉）、max tokens=4096、最大迭代上限 10000（用于观察智能体能持续对话多久及重复趋势），每个配对运行两次且行为无实质差异。任务为单一开放性任务 "Write a mathematical game of Fibonacci"，以避免任务复杂度混淆。12 种配对覆盖对称（同模型不同规模）、非对称（大小模型组合）、跨架构（含通用模型与代码/推理型模型）三类；部署于 RTX 5090（32GB VRAM）与 NVIDIA GB10（128GB 统一内存）两台服务器，Ollama 0.12.10 推理，Python 3.10.12 编排。分析方法：RQ1 对对话日志做主题分析（Braun & Clarke），由两位作者独立编码并以 Cohen's κ=0.71 校验一致性，归纳出成功/失败模式（SFP1 成功收敛、SFP2 未启动、SFP3 启动后发散）与对话行为模式（CBP1 回声、CBP2 浅层交互、CBP3 跨语言/平台偏离、CBP4 结论式收敛）；RQ2 归纳式主题分类并合并细粒度主题；RQ3 测量每轮词数、BLEU（程序员输出对设计师上轮的匹配度）与 ROUGE（设计师内容在程序员回复中的召回度），并结合人工标注判断每轮所处的 SE 活动（设计、实现、重构、测试、验证）；RQ4 用 GCC 11.4.0 抽取对话中的 C 代码编译，每个轮次判定为编译成功/失败/未找到代码。

Result: RQ1：仅 DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 从第一轮起即产出正确解并维持至最后一轮；Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1（3 轮后）、DeepSeek-R1:LLaMA 3.3（21 轮后）、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3（69 轮后）启动于正确解但随后发散且未恢复，其余配对从未得到正确解。多数配对在若干轮后出现 CBP1 回声（Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1 9730 轮、Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 9678 轮、DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 7655 轮）；Gemma3:Gemma3 为唯一出现 CBP4 结论式道别的配对；Gemma3:MiniCPM、DeepSeek-R1:LLaMA 3.3、LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 出现中文等跨语言漂移（CBP3）。语言分布为 C 61%、C++ 37.9%、Python 1.1%，个别配对还产出 C#/JavaScript；DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3:Qwen3 及 LLaMA:LLaMA 变体未使用英语与 C 以外的语言。RQ2：主题高度多样，最高频为 Fibonacci 程序（28.13%）、二项式系数计算（25.25%）、C 头文件使用讨论（25.16%）；Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1 与 Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 主题分布极度偏斜（长上须与 log 轴远点），DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 中位数与离散度显著更高，Gemma3:Gemma3 等则较均衡；LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 与 Gemma3:Gemma2 主题探索更宽（排序、打印程序、CLI 工具等），DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM 是唯一引入指针程序等冷门主题的配对。RQ3：Qwen3:Qwen3 与 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 的 BLEU 高而平稳（非平坦），对应真实语义对齐且持续变化；DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 与 Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1 的 BLEU/ROUGE 平坦于 1.0，属语义回声——前者虽语义质量低却维持了收敛；Gemma3:Gemma3、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 出现延迟的 BLEU/ROUGE 尖峰。词数小提琴图显示 Designer 普遍比 Programmer 冗长，但对称性差异极大：DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM、Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1、LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 极度失衡（常伴停滞/回声），而 LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2、Qwen3:Qwen3、LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 双方分布交叠但有区分，说明同模型配对并不必然回声。人工分析进一步发现 Gemma3:Gemma3 与 LLaMA 3.2:DeepSeek-R1 在若干轮后出现角色互换；所有成功启动的案例均由 Programmer 主导，而多数发散由 Designer 引入无关相关话题触发。RQ4：LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 与 Qwen3:Qwen3 编译成功率 100%；Qwen3:DeepSeek-R1、Gemma3:DeepSeek-R1、Gemma3:MiniCPM 处于 45–77% 的中档；DeepSeek-R1:MiniCPM 与 LLaMA 3.3:LLaMA 3.3 降至约 30–40%，失败率高达 62%；Gemma3:Gemma3 与 DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 的"未找到代码"占比达 68–95%，人工核查发现多因双方共同给出编译/执行指令而非代码。

Conclusion: 多智能体编程的性能主要取决于角色分离、配对兼容性与交互动态，而非模型规模或表面词汇相似度；收敛性、语义对齐与编译成功率三者不一致——强对齐不保证正确，正确收敛也可能伴随回声等"病态"交互特征，推理能力本身不足以保证稳定协作。实证上"早期正确解的出现可预测最终成功"，一旦发散则极少恢复（观测上限 69 轮），这为多智能体 SE 系统定义显式停止条件、交互轨迹监控（重复率、主题黏附度、角色稳定性）与终止策略提供了依据；推理模型与非推理模型配对存在语义回声而任务不推进的风险，同模型非推理配对（LLaMA 3.2/3.3、Qwen3）则在需求协商、设计探索、重构等长对话场景更有潜力。作者承认有效性威胁：单一任务与单一语言、固定提示与角色条件、仅 12 种开源组合，难以推广到闭源模型与更复杂任务；BLEU/ROUGE 亦难以捕捉改写式正确性，故辅以人工标注与收敛分析。后续工作将扩展至更复杂任务、更多配对与更丰富工具集成，并区分 DeepSeek-R1 的收敛源自推理式设计还是模型规模；论文另发布包含对话数据集、编排代码与复现说明的开放复现包。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering (SE), yet their potential for autonomous, role-oriented collaboration remains largely underexplored. Understanding how multiple LLM-based agents coordinate, maintain role alignment, and converge on solutions is critical for SE, as naively allowing agents to interact does not reliably lead to correct or stable outcomes. Recent empirical studies show that unstructured or poorly understood interaction dynamics can result in error propagation, premature consensus on incorrect solutions, or prolonged disagreement that prevents convergence, even when correct partial solutions are present early in the interaction. As an initial step towards addressing this underexplored area, we undertake a systematic analysis of conversations between two agents, a Designer and a Programmer across 12 model combinations from 7 open-source LLMs (Gemma 2, Gemma 3, LLaMA 3.2, LLaMA 3.3, DeepSeek-R1, MiniCPM, and Qwen3). Our systematic approach reveals three key dimensions of multi-agent interaction: efficiency (the speed and stability of convergence), consistency (the degree of role alignment visualized by BLEU and ROUGE), and effectiveness (the extent of compilation success and error resolution). Results show that the DeepSeek-R1:DeepSeek-R1 pair was unique in converging to the correct solution from the very first iteration and sustaining it consistently to the final iteration, while LLaMA 3.2:LLaMA 3.2 and Qwen3:Qwen3 demonstrated strong Designer:Programmer role alignment despite of diverging from the correct solution. The other pairs deviated from the task, never to converge to a result. These findings advance understanding of agentic programming and highlight the need for further research on understanding and calibrating convergence and stop conditions essential for future autonomous SE.

</details>


### [214] [Towards Evaluation Engineering: An Empirical Study of ML Evaluation Harnesses in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24213)
*Zhimin Zhao,Zehao Wang,Abdul Ali Bangash,Bram Adams,Ahmed E. Hassan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文对57个ML评估框架进行大规模实证分析，建立了五阶段评估框架模型，分类了16,560个问题，发现超过40%的运营挑战集中在规范阶段，三大根本原因（功能未实现、文档缺失、输入验证缺失）占问题的61.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估框架在机器学习基础设施中扮演关键角色，但其运营挑战和工程问题此前关注有限。需要系统性地理解这些挑战的本质和分布。

Method: 对57个评估框架进行实证研究，推导出五阶段框架模型，并对16,560个问题按工作流阶段和根本原因进行分类分析。

Result: 运营挑战主要集中在规范阶段（41.4%）；三大根本原因是功能未实现（24.3%）、文档缺失（20.3%）和输入验证缺失（17.3%），共占61.7%；不同阶段的问题类型差异显著：配置阶段以环境不兼容和外部依赖损坏为主（36.2%），评估阶段以算法错误（25.9%）和验证缺失（22.5%）为主。

Conclusion: 建立了一个实证基础，将评估工程视为一个独立的软件工程关注领域。研究揭示了评估框架的主要痛点集中在规范阶段，并为改进ML评估基础设施提供了数据驱动的指导。

Abstract: Evaluation harnesses are software systems that orchestrate model evaluation by managing model invocation, data loading, metric computation, and result reporting. Despite their critical role in machine learning infrastructure, their operational challenges and engineering concerns have received limited attention so far. We present an empirical study of 57 evaluation harnesses, deriving a five-stage harness model and classifying 16,560 issues by workflow stage and root cause. Most harness operational challenges concentrate in the Specification stage (41.4% of issues), where harnesses integrate external models, datasets, and scoring judges. The three most frequent root causes of operational challenges are unimplemented features (24.3%), documentation gaps (20.3%), and missing input validation (17.2%), which together account for 61.7% of classified issues, spanning both defects in existing functionality and capability gaps that block intended workflows. Root causes also vary by workflow stage: environment incompatibility and external dependency breakage account for 36.2% of provisioning issues, whereas algorithmic error (25.9%) and validation gap (22.5%) dominate assessment issues. Together, these contributions establish an empirical foundation for treating evaluation engineering as a distinct software engineering concern.

</details>


### [215] [Can Graph-Based Microservice Performance Detection Be Used for Microservice Intrusion Detection?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24283)
*Yunjian Ma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: This paper explores using graph-based microservice performance detection as a foundation for intrusion detection, achieving 96.2% accuracy on 6-way classification across normal and attack traffic using GCN on request-level invocation graphs with multi-modal features, while revealing that stricter trial-level evaluation shows limitations of the approach.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing microservice performance anomaly detection increasingly models systems as graphs; this paper investigates whether such graph-based approaches can extend to intrusion detection, combining performance monitoring with security detection.

Method: Docker Compose-based e-commerce microservice benchmark with 50 controlled trials across five attack types; request traces converted to request-level invocation graphs with multi-modal node features; two-layer graph convolutional network (GCN) for 6-way classification over 21,438 request graphs.

Result: 96.2% test accuracy with macro F1 of 0.955 under graph-level random split; modality ablation confirms logs and metrics improve detection; trial-level split evaluation shows trace structure alone is insufficient; flattened baselines outperform shallow graph model.

Conclusion: Graph-level random split achieves 96.2% accuracy, but stricter trial-level evaluation reveals that trace structure alone is insufficient; multi-modal features (logs + metrics) improve detection, and strong flattened baselines currently outperform the shallow graph model on the engineered feature set.

Abstract: Microservice systems expose rich telemetry streams, including metrics, logs, and distributed traces. Existing performance anomaly detection methods increasingly model these systems as graphs, where nodes represent services and edges represent runtime dependencies. This paper asks whether graph-based microservice performance detection can also serve as a foundation for microservice intrusion detection. We deploy a Docker Compose based synthetic e-commerce microservice benchmark, run 50 controlled trials across five attack types under normal workloads, and collect metrics, logs, and distributed traces. Each request trace is converted into a request-level invocation graph with multi-modal node features derived from timestamped logs and per-service performance metrics. As a first baseline, we train a two-layer graph convolutional network for 6-way classification over 21,438 request graphs. The model achieves 96.2% test accuracy with a macro F1 of 0.955 under a graph-level random split. We then conduct modality ablation, trial-level split evaluation, non-graph baseline comparison, runtime analysis, t-SNE visualization, confusion-matrix analysis, and error-case inspection. The stricter trial-level results show that trace structure alone is insufficient, logs and metrics improve detection, and strong flattened baselines currently outperform the shallow graph model on the engineered feature set.

</details>


### [216] [Breaking Changes in Software Ecosystems: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24397)
*Juntao Chen,Tingting Bi,Yanlin Wang,Patanamon Thongtanunam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是首篇面向软件生态系统的破坏性变更（breaking changes）系统性文献综述（SLR），遵循 Kitchenham 与 Charters 指南，检索 IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、Springer 三大数据库（2010–2026），经两阶段筛选与双向滚雪球获得 97 篇一手研究，覆盖 Maven/Java、npm/JavaScript、Python、Web API、Linux 发行版五个生态。核心产出四点：(1) 提出 Nature/Detectability/Scope/Visibility 四维分类体系；(2) 归纳 5 类成因与 5 个影响维度，发现维护与设计改进类变更占比高于新功能开发；(3) 评述 43 种检测方法，其对语法级破坏准确率高、行为级破坏覆盖有限；(4) 按行为主体角色组织 66 项沟通、预防与恢复策略。据此提出三大挑战（规模化行为破坏检测、语义化版本作为信任机制的失效、信息不对称下的传递性依赖传播）与三大机会（LLM 辅助的行为契约推断、生态级依赖图智能、面向 ML/数据科学领域专用工具）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件高度依赖可复用库构成的依赖网络，库接口或行为的任何改动都会沿依赖图（含大量消费者未显式声明的传递依赖）向下游传播，导致编译失败、运行时错误与迁移成本。语义化版本（SemVer）虽被广泛采用为兼容性信号，但其约定被系统性违反——minor/patch 版本频繁引入破坏性变更，使消费者无法仅凭版本号判断升级是否安全，进而延迟升级。此外，行为级（behavioral）破坏会静默改变运行时语义，绕过类型系统与静态分析，威胁开源软件供应链完整性（贡献者流失使关键包高度依赖少数维护者），且供应链安全与可靠性已成为产业界与监管层持续关注点。

已有研究多孤立展开：或聚焦特定语言/包管理器的检测技术，或只分析对下游消费者的影响，或仅考察维护者引入变更的原因。最接近的二次研究 Lamothe et al. (2021) 覆盖 369 篇 API 演化文献，但仅将破坏性变更列为 API 可用性之下的一个议题，未做分类也未以其为核心对象；另有关于 API 属性自动推断（Robillard et al., 2013）与重构对 API 演化作用（Kim et al., 2011）的相邻综述，以及跨打包生态依赖问题的比较分析（Decan et al., 2017），仅触及"症状之一"。因此缺乏跨生态、覆盖"分类—成因—检测—管理"全生命周期的综合性综述。

Method: 方法：遵循 Kitchenham & Charters (2007) 的 SLR 指南，分四阶段。

(1) 文献收集：以破坏性变更及其同义词（Breaking Change / Backward Incompatible Change / API Breakage / Library Breakage / Dependency Breakage 等 21 个检索项，OR 组合）对 IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、Springer 做标题/摘要/关键词/索引词/正文全文本检索，时间窗 2010–2026（起始年理由为现代包生态兴起且相关研究集中于此），限定计算机科学学科；得 1102+660+1233=2995 篇，去重后 2750 篇候选。

(2) 筛选过滤：两阶段。第一阶段五项排除标准（E1 少于 5 页；E2 无与破坏性变更相关的评估或实证；E3 仅边缘性提及；E4 灰色文献；E5 重复或早期版本），由第一作者使用大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.7）依据标题与摘要做初评，再由作者逐篇复核并做最终排除决定（模型仅作筛选辅助），共排除约 2695 篇（E3 占 2265 篇，因全文本检索召回较宽，含依赖更新实践、SemVer 合规分析、发布说明/弃用/漏洞修复等仅把破坏性变更作为风险或议题之一的文献，以及电信标准等术语误匹配）；第二阶段第一作者全文阅读剩余 55 篇，按两项纳入标准（I1 直接针对破坏性变更的实证研究/技术/框架/工具；I2 提供分类、成因、影响、检测、沟通、预防或恢复的可操作证据）判定，保留 50 篇作为种子集。

(3) 引文扩展：对种子集做前向（Google Scholar 引用）与后向（参考文献）滚雪球，同一标准评审；对窗口内高被引的 2010 年前奠基性工作放宽年份限制；迭代至无新增；新增 47 篇，总计 97 篇。会议版与期刊扩展版仅在引入新研究问题/新生态/扩展数据集时同时纳入；已通过同行评审但仅有 arXiv 预印本的论文亦纳入。

(4) 数据分析与综合：设计 10 项数据抽取模式（D1–D4 书目与情境信息，D5 类型→RQ1，D6 成因与 D7 影响→RQ2，D8 检测技术→RQ3，D9 预防与 D10 缓解→RQ4）。质性分析：RQ1 采用三轮开放卡片分类（术语抽取→常量比较法聚类归一→层级化组织，顶/底双向迭代至稳定）；RQ2–RQ4 采用 Cruzes & Dyba (2011) 主题分析三阶段（逐行初始编码→主题生成→综合与结构化）。可靠性：前两位作者独立抽取与编码并交叉核对，分歧经讨论至共识；讨论分歧消解。描述统计：72% 发表于会议（ICSE 9、FSE/ESEC 8、SANER 7），25% 期刊（EMSE 7、JSS 6、TOSEM 5、TSE 3），其余为 2 篇博士论文与 1 篇预印本；2020–2026 年占 61 篇（63%）。

Result: RQ1（四维分类）：Nature 区分语法性（破坏类型签名/可见性/接口定义，可在编译、链接或静态分析暴露）与行为性（保持语法接口但改变运行时语义，如异常行为、返回值、状态管理）；21 篇相关论文中 18 篇关注语法性，但 npm 实证（Kong et al.，1,519 次变更）中行为性占 68.1%，说明研究注意力偏离真实分布；跨生态观察为"生态惯例与发布实践比静态/动态类型范式更能塑造破坏形态"。Detectability 分编译时、链接时（二进制不兼容）与运行时三阶段，9 篇实证全部集中于 Java/Maven；关键发现是源码—二进制不对称（返回值具体化、参数宽化、静态常量内联陈旧导致静默错误值，示例中重试循环仍跑 3 次而非 5 次），且开发者自评对二进制兼容性的判断显著弱于源码兼容性（仅 30% 能正确判断参数宽化、27% 能识别返回值具体化为二进制不兼容）；运行时破坏是唯一无自动安全网的类别。Scope 分直接/传递与广泛/局部；传递性破坏占客户端受影响源码破坏的约 20.36% 且为最主要原因，61.24% 客户端在未显式声明的情况下使用传递依赖功能；11.58% 依赖更新（最新版）导致客户端破坏、4.35%（相邻版本）；87% 的 Maven 公开方法从未被其他库调用，故多数破坏影响局部，且热门与冷门方法的破坏率相当（维护者难以知晓哪些方法被广泛使用）；67% 的 Maven 制品历史上至少违反过一次 SemVer。Visibility 分 Public/Internal/Beta/Deprecated/Experimental：约五分之一的非 major Maven 版本仍引入公共 API 破坏；4.8% 客户端使用内部 API 且其更新破坏率 20.6% 高于整体均值 11.58%，Eclipse 有 327K 个稳定的"非 API"方法可提升为正式 API；@Beta 在前 1000 个 Maven 库中出现 1451 次但不稳定 API 机制缺乏标准化，九款 Java 兼容性工具均存在漏检；弃用 API 适配缓慢（Pharo：118 次变更中 53% 引发生态反应，中位反应时间 34 天，方法替换 20 天快于方法改进 47 天）。维度间存在交互：Nature→Detectability、Visibility→Scope。

RQ2（成因与影响）：五类成因按发起者归为三组——库内部决策（内部维护与重构、防御性设计与健壮性、功能演化）、外部强加（生态集成与约束，唯一不可由维护者规避的类别）、非预期后果（反应性/意外修改）。维护与设计类合计超过功能交付：Java 中 API 简化 29%（17/59）+ 可维护性改进 24%（14/59）=53%，高于新功能实现 32%（19/59）；npm 中仅"改进 API 设计"即占 61.8%（939/1519），其余为减少代码冗余 30.9%、改进标识符名 7.3%。意外修改占比最小但受 Hyrum 定律影响，修复 bug 仍会破坏依赖旧行为的客户端；且"为正确性/可维护性而改"常引发非预期行为破坏（Java 行为破坏与 Python 数据科学库研究均有证据）。作者明确指出这些比例来自单一研究的单一样本，尚未获得独立复现。影响侧强调传递依赖为最大单一客户端破坏来源，以及维护者与客户端开发者对影响与升级耗时的感知落差（Zaitsev et al.）。

RQ3（检测）：评述 43 种静态、动态、学习式与混合检测/分析方法并比较权衡。语法性破坏检测成熟度高（编译/链接/字节码或 AST 差分、JLS/JVMS 一致性规则），行为性破坏覆盖有限，因其无编译器/链接器/运行时异常信号，只能依赖测试覆盖与跨版本回归测试（多数项目缺失），且与版本约束解析后的潜伏显现耦合（如 npm 宽松版本区间使破坏延迟暴露）。Java 兼容性工具被评估均存在特定不兼容漏检。

RQ4（管理与应对）：综合 66 项沟通、预防与恢复策略，按执行者角色组织（库维护者、客户端开发者、平台/生态治理方等），覆盖变更公告与弃用流程、版本与发布实践、兼容性测试与门禁、迁移指南与自动化升级、依赖固定与锁定、破坏后的修复与回滚路径等。

挑战与机会：挑战为规模化行为破坏检测、SemVer 作为信任机制的失效（非 major 版本静默破坏导致消费者延迟升级）、信息不对称下的传递性依赖传播；机会为 LLM 辅助的行为契约推断（区分有意改进与回归）、生态级依赖图智能（预测与追踪传递性破坏）、面向 ML 与数据科学的领域专用工具（应对 scikit-learn/NumPy/Pandas 中以默认参数变更（DABC）为代表的静默行为漂移，通用工具无法覆盖）。

Conclusion: 本文以 97 篇一手研究为基础，提供了首个以破坏性变更为中心、跨五个主流软件生态、覆盖全生命周期的系统性综合，贡献包括四维分类体系、五类成因与五维影响、43 种检测方法的比较评述与 66 项按角色组织的管理策略，形成了一套可用于跨研究比较的统一词汇与可视化框架，并指出"生态惯例而非语言范式塑造破坏形态""行为性破坏才是真实主体却研究最少""热门 API 并不会因热度而更受保护"等反直觉发现。基于此，作者主张：(1) 将检测重心从语法层推进到行为层，并探索 LLM 辅助的行为契约推断；(2) 将分析粒度从单库提升到生态级依赖图，以在破坏传播前预测与溯源；(3) 面向 ML/数据科学等静默行为漂移高发领域构建专用工具。同时 SemVer 需被重新审视为失效的信任机制，而非继续作为兼容性信号的唯一依据。方法学上的注意事项包括：检索时间为 2026 年 4 月、2010 年下限可能遗漏早期奠基工作（已通过滚雪球部分缓解）、第一阶段筛选由单一作者主导（LLM 仅作辅助）、成因占比数据尚缺独立复现、部分维度实证证据高度集中于 Java/Maven 生态（可检测性维度 9 篇全部如此），这构成对结论普适性与生态覆盖均衡性的主要威胁，也是论文第 8 节讨论的效度威胁所在。

Abstract: Modern software systems rely on dependency networks of reusable libraries, where breaking changes propagate and cause downstream consumers to fail. Despite growing research across ecosystems, no comprehensive synthesis exists. We conduct a systematic literature review of 97 primary studies, answering four research questions across five ecosystems: Maven/Java, npm/JavaScript, Python, Web APIs, and Linux distributions. The synthesis yields four results. First, a four-dimensional taxonomy along Nature, Detectability, Scope, and Visibility. Second, five reason categories and five impact dimensions, where maintenance and design improvements account for a larger share of breaking changes than new feature work. Third, 43 detection approaches that reach high accuracy on syntactic breaks but limited coverage on behavioral ones. Fourth, 66 strategies for communicating, preventing, and recovering from breaking changes, organized by the actor's role. Based on these findings, we identify three open challenges and three research opportunities. The challenges are behavioral break detection at scale, the failure of semantic versioning as a trust mechanism, and transitive dependency propagation under information asymmetry. The opportunities are LLM-augmented behavioral contract inference, ecosystem-level dependency graph intelligence, and domain-specific tooling for ML and data science.

</details>


### [217] [Beyond AI Delegation: A Prompt Pattern Framework for Productive Struggle and Evaluative Judgement in Secure Coding Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24447)
*Philipp Haindl,Oliver Eigner,Peter Kieseberg*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一套“提示词模式（Prompt Pattern）”框架，将软件工程文献中的九个提示工程模式映射到“生产性挣扎（Productive Struggle）”与“评价性判断（Evaluative Judgement）”两个教学构念上，并以硕士层次“高级安全编码”课程设计（DELTA 框架）作为应用示例，展示了如何让 GenAI 留在课堂中却不替代学生的认知劳动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini）使学生轻易将写作、分析与问题求解外包给模型，绕过“生产性挣扎”——即 learners 面对超出当前理解的任务时被迫重组知识结构、从而形成可迁移理解的阶段。风险不在于“使用 AI”，而在于使用方式只产出结果而不产出理解；在安全编码等领域浅层知识后果尤为严重。既有机构应对手段（封禁 AI、设计查 AI 文本的评估、或无视问题）均不可持续。缺失的是“如何在课程中整合 AI 而不替代学生认知工作”的实操指南。作者认为提示工程正是连接教学意图与课程实践的缺失环节：随手写的提示词只换来答案，精心设计的提示词可以迫使学生先分析再听解释、先比较再采纳建议、先论证再获确认。

Method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法，依据 Hevner 等的四阶段流程：（1）问题识别——生产性挣扎被侵蚀 + 缺乏实操性整合指引；（2）目标界定——构件需足够具体可转化为课堂活动、足够通用可跨 CS 主题适配、且基于有文献支撑的教学构念；（3）构件设计——三步：文献综述确定 PS 与 EJ 为受威胁核心能力；对比 White 等与 Pai 的提示模式目录，筛选教育相关模式并采用 Pai 的六分类作为组织结构（最终归并为四类九模式）；将每个模式映射到具体教学功能（脚手架分析、引发比较、强制论证、揭示 AI 局限）；（4）演示——在硕士研究方法课程中部署，学生显式学习分类法并用其撰写论文开题提案（基于 Design Science Canvas），获得哪些模式自然、哪些需更多脚手架的初步反馈。框架定位为嵌套于既有课程设计框架（讨论了 Constructive Alignment、3R、TPACK、DELTA）之内而非替代 thereof，最终以 DELTA（Context、Outcomes、Activities、Assessment、Reflection）五步设计“高级安全编码”模块作为完整案例。

Result: 产出包含九种提示模式的分类体系：输出定制类（Persona、Template）、错误识别类（Fact Check List）、反思类（Cognitive Verifier、Question Refinement、Alternative Approaches）、交互类（Flipped Interaction、Game Play），每种模式均附教育理据与 CS/安全语境示例。安全编码模块中三项活动分别由三种模式支撑：Flipped Interaction 用于引导式漏洞发现（AI 一次一问地苏格拉底式提问，学生自主从 Flask 登录处理器的 SQL 注入缺陷中定位问题）、Alternative Approaches 用于比较式修复（要求参数化查询、SQLAlchemy ORM、自定义净化函数三方案权衡对比表，学生须自行论证选择）、Cognitive Verifier 用于监督式实现（逐步分解重构并说明每步安全性理由，形成可见推理轨迹）。评估采用四要素作品集：对话日志、书面论证（按权衡推理质量而非所选方案评分）、对照 OWASP Top 10 核查的重构代码、模板辅助生成的 PR 描述，作者认为该设计具有抗作弊性，因外包全项目的学生无法伪造分析过程与权衡推理。局限方面按构念效度、内部效度、外部效度三类威胁说明：LLM 能力演进可能使显式模式过时（构件应版本化管理）；安全编码模块仅为设计构件，DSR 演示发生在另一门研究方法课程中，无受控测量，故无法报告学生表现；验证仅在一所高校的一个硕士项目中完成，跨层次、跨学科迁移性待检验。后续计划为受控部署该安全编码模块，含安全推理能力前后测、以对话日志为数据源、采集结构化学生反馈。

Conclusion: GenAI 对学习是助力还是阻碍，取决于提示如何设计而非工具本身：劣质提示让 AI 取代学生思考，优质提示则能强制课程本就要培养的思考方式。该分类法为教师提供了刻意选择的共同词汇——九个模式、四个类别、每个模式对应明确教学功能；安全编码模块则展示了三活动三模式的实践形态，分别保留评估本无法观察的推理过程的不同侧面。作者视其为第一迭代版本：把工程模式映射到教学目标的概念性工作本身即是独立贡献，且是 AI 进入计算机科学教育讨论中长期缺失的一环；下一步是在真实课程中做受控实证评估（预后测 + 对话日志分析 + 学生反馈），计划于下一学年开展。

Abstract: Large language models make it easy for students to delegate writing, analysis, and problem-solving to automated systems, bypassing the effortful engagement that produces lasting understanding. We introduce a practical framework that helps educators keep GenAI in the course without removing the cognitive demands that make it worthwhile. We apply Design Science Research (DSR) to synthesise and adapt a taxonomy of nine prompt engineering patterns from established catalogs in the computer science literature, mapped to two pedagogical constructs: Productive Struggle and Evaluative Judgement. A course design for an Advanced Secure Coding module, structured using the DELTA framework, demonstrates the artifact's applicability. Nine prompt patterns, each mapped to a specific pedagogical function, give instructors fine-grained control over how students interact with AI. The secure coding design shows how three patterns (Flipped Interaction, Alternative Approaches, and Cognitive Verifier) scaffold vulnerability discovery and remediation while keeping students in the reasoning role. The framework provides a replicable approach to designing AI-augmented learning experiences that preserve student reasoning, and establishes a structured basis for future empirical evaluation in live course settings.

</details>


### [218] [Code2UML: Agentic LLMs with context engineering for scalable software visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24453)
*Alin-Gabriel Văduva,Anca-Ioana Andreescu,Simona-Vasilica Oprea,Adela Bâra*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Claude Agent SDK 的智能体（agentic）架构，结合"上下文工程"实现从源代码仓库自动生成 UML 图。当项目 IR 超出 LLM 上下文窗口时，由一个确定性、重要性加权的 IR 压缩层将其裁剪为符合 token 限制的图特定视图，无需 LLM 调用、毫秒级完成。该系统在 12 个开源仓库、4 种语言（Java、JavaScript、PHP、Python）、7 类 UML 图上评估，共 84 次观测、5 项自动指标：语法有效性均值 91.5%（组件图与部署图达 100%），关系精确率均值 0.858，结构质量均值 81.7/100（跨语言差异仅 3.1 分），实体召回率均值 0.313（体现"架构优先"而非穷尽覆盖的刻意取舍）；在 31 至 4,578 个 IR 实体的敏感性分析中，质量分数对规模保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码分析工具已被用于自动化软件文档生成任务，但其面向真实代码库时的可扩展性尚未得到充分研究：当项目的中间表示（IR）规模超过 LLM 上下文窗口限制时，模型无法一次性摄取全量语义信息，导致生成质量下降或流程失败。此外，通用型 LLM 驱动的图表生成在关系准确性、跨语言一致性和图类型适配性方面缺乏细粒度的评测证据。本文的动机在于：① 提出一种能在 IR 超限时仍稳定工作的端到端自动 UML 生成架构；② 将"认知任务分解"与"上下文工程"结合，使多智能体流水线能够规模化处理真实代码库；③ 用系统的多仓库、多语言、多图类型评测量化该方案的有效性与局限。

Method: 方法上，论文构建了一个包含五个专职智能体的层级式 agentic 架构（基于 Claude Agent SDK 实现），各自承担不同的认知子任务：PlannerAgent（规划待生成图类型与抽取范围）、AnalyzerAgent（语义分析源码并抽取实体与关系）、DiagramAgent（生成 UML 图表文本/结构）、CorrectorAgent（校验并修正语法与关系错误）、DependencyAnalyzerAgent（解析跨实体依赖以支撑组件图、部署图等结构性关系）。关键创新是位于分析层与生成层之间的"确定性、重要性加权 IR 压缩层"：它通过可解释的静态启发式规则（实体重要性打分、关系重要性排序、图类型相关的过滤与裁剪）把全项目 IR 转换为"图特定视图"，在数学上保证输出 token 数不超过上下文约束；该层不依赖任何 LLM 推理，因此延迟以毫秒计，且行为可复现、可审计。评测设计为：在 12 个开源仓库上，覆盖 Java、JavaScript、PHP、Python 4 种语言与 7 种 UML 图类型，共得到 84 条观测记录；采用 5 项自动化指标，分别度量语法有效性（图表是否可被解析）、关系精确率（生成的关系与真实依赖的一致性）、结构质量（综合评分，满分 100）、实体召回率，以及跨语言/跨规模的一致性；另设敏感性分析，将 IR 实体规模从 31 扩展到 4,578，考察质量分数是否随规模漂移。

Result: 实验结果显示：（1）语法有效性均值 91.5%，其中组件图与部署图达到 100%，说明结构规约最强、依赖分析最充分的图类型表现最佳；（2）关系精确率均值 0.858，表明生成的关系大多能对应真实代码依赖；（3）结构质量均值 81.7/100，跨语言方差仅 3.1 分，显示该架构对语言差异不敏感、结果可迁移；（4）实体召回率均值 0.313，明显偏低，作者将其解释为架构层面的"刻意优先级排序"结果——系统优先保留高重要性、图表语义相关的实体，而非追求穷尽覆盖，这解释了精确率高而召回率低的权衡关系；（5）敏感性分析覆盖 31–4,578 个 IR 实体，质量分数保持稳定，验证了压缩层在规模增长下的鲁棒性与可扩展性。总体而言，多智能体分工 + 确定性上下文压缩的组合有效突破了 LLM 上下文窗口对真实代码库文档化的限制。

Conclusion: 结论部分表明，这一"层级式多智能体 + 确定性上下文工程"的架构能够在 IR 规模远超 LLM 上下文限制的真实代码库上可靠地自动生成 UML 图，其确定性压缩层无需 LLM 调用且耗时以毫秒计，是实现可扩展、廉价且可复现文档自动化的关键机制。实验证明质量指标对项目规模（31 至 4,578 实体）与编程语言均不敏感，支持方法的通用性。论文同时坦诚指出核心局限：实体召回率均值仅 0.313，说明系统偏向架构关键实体的抽象概括而非完整建模，面向需要穷尽类图覆盖的使用场景仍需改进；未来工作可包括提升低重要性实体的召回、引入更丰富的语义重要性权重与增量/分层生成策略，以及扩大评测仓库与图类型样本以增强统计结论的普适性。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based code analysis tools are adopted to automate software documentation tasks. However, the scalability of these approaches to real codebases, where Intermediate Representations (IR) exceed LLM context limits, remains underexplored. This paper introduces an agentic architecture with context engineering for automated UML diagram generation from source code repositories. It employs a hierarchy of five specialized agents: PlannerAgent, AnalyzerAgent, DiagramAgent, CorrectorAgent and DependencyAnalyzerAgent, built on the Claude Agent SDK, each addressing a distinct cognitive subtask. A deterministic, importance-weighted IR compaction layer transforms full project IRs into diagram-specific views guaranteed to fit within token constraints, requiring no LLM calls and completing in milliseconds. Thus, we evaluate the system across 12 open-source repositories in 4 programming languages (Java, JavaScript, PHP, Python) and 7 UML diagram types, producing 84 observations assessed on 5 automated metrics. Results demonstrate high syntactic validity (mean: 91.5%, with component and deployment diagrams reaching 100%), strong relationship precision (mean: 0.858) and consistent structural quality (mean: 81.7/100, with cross-language variance of 3.1 points). Entity recall averaged 0.313, reflecting deliberate architectural prioritization over exhaustive coverage. A sensitivity analysis (31 to 4,578 IR entities) confirms that quality scores remain stable regardless of scale.

</details>


### [219] [SmellDoc: Extending Elastic Stack for Microservice Bad Smell Detection and Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24471)
*Yongchao Xing,Weipan Yang,Yiming Lv,Dianhui Chu,Zhiying Tu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SmellDoc 是一个基于 Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch + Kibana）扩展的 Kibana 插件框架，将微服务坏味道（microservice bad smells, MBSs）检测、知识库与系统健康监控三合一集成到 Elastic 可观测性仪表盘中。它通过自定义业务采集器（Custom-Business-Collector, CBC）采集业务级指标、重新整合采集器（Re-integration Collector, RIC）聚合异构运行数据，并结合静态分析与运行时分析检测 24 种代表性坏味道（知识库共收录 84 种），最终在 Kibana 中以多视图形式可视化，辅助运维人员快速定位与修复问题、提升 QoS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务已成为主流架构范式，但不良设计与开发实践导致的微服务坏味道会损害可维护性、可扩展性与性能并引入缺陷。现有检测工具（如 MARS）仅输出难以解读的 JSON 结果；部分工作（MAIG、μFRESHENER）虽能在服务拓扑图中可视化坏味道，却无法说明坏味道如何影响系统运行时。因此核心挑战是：将 MBS 检测与运行时可观测性深度融合，使运维人员能够直观关联坏味道与运行指标，从而支持及时重构与决策。之所以选择 Elastic Stack，是因为 Prometheus 擅长基础设施监控但缺乏链路追踪支持，OpenTelemetry 虽统一采集规范但需要外部可视化，而 Elastic Stack 提供链路追踪、依赖分析与 Kibana 内置可视化，且可通过插件扩展。

Method: 框架采用三步流水线：(1) 配置阶段——在原生 elastic-apm-agent 之外引入基于 Elastic APM SDK 与 Byte Buddy 实现的自定义代理 CBC，通过拦截 Spring 服务方法，用 Micrometer 记录调用指标并上报 APM Server，实现超越系统级的业务粒度监控；两代理随服务在 Kubernetes 中启动。(2) 数据采集阶段——RIC 周期性从 Elasticsearch 拉取运行数据，过滤冗余记录并聚合三类来源：外部指标（trace 链路、SQL 调用、跨服务依赖）、内部指标（JVM 级别 CPU/内存/GC）与业务指标（CBC 提供的服务级调用频次），规范化索引后回写 Elasticsearch。(3) 检测与可视化阶段——由 MBST 框架衍生的静态分析组件提取服务元数据、拓扑与细粒度特征，用规则检查检测 12 种架构级坏味道（如 ESB Usage、Microservice Greedy），结果与静态指标输入 MBSD 组件，再由 Elasticsearch 的运行时数据增强，检测 12 种运行时坏味道，合计 24 种，结果均存入 Elasticsearch。MBSD 插件集成进 Elastic Observability 仪表盘，提供三个标签页：坏味道知识页（按类型给出标准化定义与历史记录）、监控页（K8s 部署的系统级视图，含服务/实例 KPI）、检测页（当前分布与统计、算法在线/离线状态、可视化趋势、单服务历史图表与 JSON）。

Result: 在开源微服务系统 Property Management Cloud（基于 Spring Cloud 的物业管理云，含五个微服务模块）上部署于 Kubernetes 集群并与 SmellDoc 全部组件一同运行进行案例验证。检测卡片示例显示系统执行了 29 次 MBS 检测，其中 11 次报告检出坏味道；双环饼图内环按 Primary Type/Secondary Type 展示 MBS 类型占比，外环展示检出（true）与未检出（false）比例，便于快速定位需重点治理的类别；历史结果图显示三个时间窗口内检出坏味道，例如第一个时间窗口在 cloud-user-service 中检出 No API Versioning 与 No API-Gateway。案例表明 SmellDoc 在检测、可视化与分析坏味道方面有效且可用，提升了运行时可观测性并加速故障排查，从而维持较高 QoS。作者同时开源了代码仓库与演示视频。

Conclusion: 本文提出并实现了 SmellDoc——一个面向 Elastic Stack 扩展的微服务坏味道检测与可视化框架，通过静态分析（架构级）与运行时分析（运行时级）结合细粒度业务指标，支持 84 种坏味道知识库与 24 种实际检测，将检测结果深度嵌入 Kibana 可观测性仪表盘。案例研究证实其有效性与可用性，说明将坏味道检测嵌入可观测性体系能够增强监控能力、加快排障速度，并有助于在微服务系统中持续保持高质量服务（QoS）。

Abstract: Microservices have become a mainstream architectural paradigm, yet microservice bad smells can significantly harm maintainability and performance. Existing detection tools often produce obscure outputs and lack effective integration with runtime observability, making it difficult for operators to interpret results and take timely action. To address this gap, we propose SmellDoc, a customized framework based on Elastic Stack. SmellDoc extends the native observability dashboard with a microservice bad smell detection plugin, integrating detection, knowledge, and health monitoring. It introduces a Custom-Business-Collector to capture business-level metrics, a Re-integration Collector to aggregate heterogeneous runtime data, and detection components that combine static and runtime analyses. SmellDoc supports a knowledge base of 84 smell types and enables detection of 24 representative smells across architectural, runtime, and performance categories. Results are visualized in Kibana through multiple views, providing operators with actionable insights. Case studies on a benchmark microservice system demonstrate that SmellDoc is effective and usable in detecting, visualizing, and analyzing smells, thus enhancing runtime observability and accelerating troubleshooting to maintain a high level of Quality of Service.

</details>


### [220] [From Prompting to Verification: How Experience Shapes Vibe Coding Practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24521)
*Ahmed Fawzy,Amjed Tahir,Kelly Blincoe*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过一项针对162名"氛围编程"（vibe coding）用户的在线问卷（按经验分为非开发者、初级开发者、专业开发者三组，各54人），系统比较了不同编程经验群体在动机、体验、AI生成代码质量感知与质量保证（QA）实践上的差异。核心发现：经验"选择性"塑造实践而非均匀塑造——三组在体验与质量感知上无显著差异（对AI代码缺陷的普遍认知相似），但在动机、交互风格和QA/调试行为上差异显著；作者将其归纳为"感知—行动鸿沟"，并指出vibe coding是"部分民主化"：创作门槛降低，但评估与验证能力未均等分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代码生成工具（ChatGPT、Copilot、Claude Code、Cursor等）已将软件开发扩展到无编程背景的人群，形成以自然语言提示生成、以执行结果为主要评估手段的"氛围编程"（vibe coding）实践。已有研究多聚焦于特定群体（专业开发者或计算机专业学生），或单独研究非专家，缺少在同一研究设计下对非开发者、初级开发者与专业开发者三类群体的系统比较，因此尚不清楚：不同经验水平的使用动机、交互方式、对代码质量的感知与QA实践有何差异；以及——更关键地——"意识到AI代码存在问题"是否会转化为有效的验证与调试行为。研究动机还包括识别哪些用户最易依赖未经验证的AI代码，并为经验感知型工具设计、教育培训与组织安全采纳规范提供依据。

Method: 采用定量横截面在线问卷（Qualtrics实现），数据来自Prolific平台：665名候选者筛出386名有vibe coding经验者，邀请260人，回收181份；经数据质量协议（完整性过滤剔除13份、<4分钟过快作答剔除6份、直线作答/零方差诊断未剔除、开放式参与度校验、更严格5分钟阈值的敏感性分析N=157）最终分析样本162人，三组各54人。问卷依据作者前期灰色文献综述（GLR）归纳的四个行为维度（动机、体验、质量感知、QA实践）与五个vibe coding风格主题构建，全部为5点Likert条目（含核心必答33题），并设可选开放题；进行了9人预测试（每组3人）。统计方法：中位数/IQR描述统计；Kruskal–Wallis H检验（效应量ε²）并用Benjamini–Hochberg FDR校正，Dunn事后检验配Holm校正；类别变量用卡方检验与Cramér's V；针对三个显著QA结果做序数Logistic回归（以经验组为主预测变量，控制每周vibe coding时长、采纳时长、每周独立编程时长），经Brant检验验证比例优势假设、GVIF检验多重共线性；开放题做轻量主题分析。

Result: RQ2（体验）与RQ3（质量感知）在三组间均无显著差异（p_BH≥.437与p_BH=.884，ε²≤.020/.008）：各组同等认可AI代码"适合快速原型但有缺陷""脆弱易错""仅适合演示不适合生产""看似正确却隐藏深层问题"。差异集中在三处：①动机——无障碍/赋能仅在非开发者与专业人员间显著（p<.001, ε²=.110），学习与探索在初级开发者中更突出（p=.015）；②交互风格——AI主导生成（ε²=.079）、交互式对话（ε²=.067）、丰富上下文提供（ε²=.047）三主题显著，非开发者更依赖AI全权生成，专业者更多迭代对话与丰富上下文，结构化规划与验证导向提示无组间差异；③QA实践——"以重提示替代手动调试"（p=.037, ε²=.045）与"调试崩溃/困惑"（p=.012, ε²=.068）差异显著，检查频率分布差异显著（χ²(8)=16.04, p=.042），约45%专业人员称"总是"检查，非开发者是唯一报告"从不"检查的群体；专业人员工作场景使用率68.5%对非开发者27.8%，工具使用上仅Claude（专业人员27.8%）有组间差异。回归分析显示组别本身不再具预测力，真正的显著预测因子是采纳时长（OR=0.84）与每周独立编程时长（OR=0.85）与更少重提示、独立编程时长与更频繁检查（OR=1.15）相关，表明QA差异由累积编码实践与工具暴露驱动。开放题期望集中于可靠性与正确性、工作流支持与控制、透明与可理解性、安全/隐私与风险控制四主题，且三组一致。

Conclusion: 经验对vibe coding的影响是选择性的：它主要塑造"为什么参与""如何交互""如何应对代码问题"，而不改变"如何使用体验"与"如何判断质量"。由此提出"感知—行动鸿沟"——对AI代码风险的一般性认知在各组广泛分布，但评估、调试与验证的行动能力仍高度依赖经验；作者明确将其定位为与数据一致的解释性假设而非已验证结论（因数据为自报）。据此将vibe coding定位为"部分民主化"实践：它拓宽了软件创作入口与风险感知，却把门槛转移至问题分解、意图表达与正确性/健壮性评估。设计上建议AI工具提供主动错误暴露、解释性支持与不确定性信号，并按经验自适应地加强脚手架；教育上应把AI代码评估作为独立技能教授；实践中需建立显式验证流程与人工评审，尤其在混合经验团队中。未来工作方向包括行为学/仓库观测验证鸿沟、脚手架机制对验证行为的影响，以及面向AI代码评估的教育干预评估。

Abstract: AI code generation tools have expanded software creation beyond professional developers, giving rise to vibe coding, a practice in which users generate software via natural-language prompts, evaluate outputs primarily by execution. Prior work has examined how AI code generation tools support programming tasks within specific user groups, typically professional developers, leaving open the question of how vibe coding practices differ across experience levels. We address this gap by surveying 162 vibe coders belonging to three user experience groups: non-coders, novices, and professional developers. Our results show that experience selectively shapes vibe coding. Reported experiences and perceptions of code quality are broadly similar across groups, with all three recognising both the strengths and limitations of vibe coding. In contrast, motivations, interaction styles, and quality assurance practices diverge with experience. Non-developers are most motivated by accessibility, novices emphasise learning and experimentation, and professionals use vibe coding more frequently in work-related contexts. We synthesise these findings as a perception--action gap: a general awareness of risks in AI-generated code is broadly distributed, but the capacity to evaluate, debug, and verify remains experience-dependent. We show that vibe coding is partially democratising as it broadens access to software creation without equally distributing the expertise to evaluate it.

</details>


### [221] [Synthesizing Inductive Invariants for Distributed Protocols via IC3 and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24619)
*Weining Cao,Guangyuan Wu,Yuan Yao,Hengfeng Wei,Taolue Chen,Xiaoxing Ma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: IC3Syn 是一个神经符号框架，在 TLA+ 状态上执行 IC3/PDR 式的框架化流程，把「全局不变式合成」分解为逐个坏状态的定向阻塞任务，由 LLM 生成协议级阻塞子句（blocking clauses），再由 IC3 控制器（配合 Apalache 符号查询与 TLC 具体筛选）逐条校验并推入帧；相邻帧相等即得到候选归纳不变式。该框架无需限制逻辑片段、无需人工模板，在 29 个分布式协议上全部求得不变式（含四个对比工具均失败的 MongoLoglessDynamicRaft 与一个复杂 Paxos 变体），并由 TLAPS 证明其在无界协议上归纳，从而确立安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式协议的安全性证明依赖归纳不变式（归纳不变式须在初始状态成立、被所有协议迁移保持、并蕴含目标安全性质），但「自动推断」而非「检查」不变式才是真正的瓶颈：现有工具要么把协议模型限制在可判定的一阶逻辑片段（如 EPR），排除常见的 TLA+ 集合/函数/量词建模模式；要么（如 Endive）直接操作 TLA+ 但需要专家精心构造的谓词池与量词模板，把合成负担转嫁给用户，实践中常需专家数周至数月。与此同时，虽然 SOTA LLM 已具备协议级推理能力，但直接要求其一次性给出完整的归纳不变式几乎无效：不变式必须同时满足初始化（initiation）、保持性（consecution）与安全蕴含，而合取式中的任何一条过强子句都会导致整体失败，且归纳性反例只针对整个合取式，无法指示究竟哪一条子句出错，LLM 因此在不同变体间反复振荡而无法收敛（论文在两阶段提交协议上观测到 Claude Opus 4.6 尝试 44 次仍超时）。因此需要一种「有原则的分解」，将全局合成任务化为一串局部、聚焦的子问题。IC3/PDR 恰好提供这种分解：它维护一列框架（frame）的过近似，通过定位前沿框架中可一步到达安全违例的坏状态、对其做后向前驱搜索，直到找到无前驱状态时才学习阻塞子句并向前传播，每一步阻塞都是局部且有针对性的。

Method: IC3Syn 由三组件构成：IC3 控制器、验证后端、LLM 模块。控制器维护显式帧序列 F = [{Init}, {Safety}]（F_i 以内部 Safety 为基并由已准入的阻塞子句强化），每轮迭代包含四个阶段：(1) 前沿查询——在最深帧中寻找一步即可到达安全违例的前驱「前沿坏状态」；(2) 前驱查询——对坏状态逐层向浅帧做后继可满足性查询，若存在前驱则下潜一层，若在 0 层以上无前驱则该状态为「无前驱状态」并触发阻塞子句搜索，若下潜到第 0 层则存在真实反例，判定 Unsafe；(3) 阻塞子句搜索——先查全局 clauseMemory 中已学子句能否阻塞（避免冗余 LLM 调用、实现跨轮复用），否则调用 LLM 生成候选；准入检查为 Init ⇒ c 与 F_{k-1} ∧ c ∧ Next ⇒ c'，通过后才插入 1..k 层帧；若阻塞失败则把坏状态留在工作表中、继续探索前沿并把新坏状态批量化，形成更丰富的上下文再交给 LLM；若再无新坏状态可产生，则以「否定所有已知坏状态」的精确聚合并取子句作为兜底（last-resort blocker）加入帧，保证有限实例上的完备性回退——这是 Endive 等扁平 CTI 消除方法所不具备的；(4) 子句推入——新帧追加后检查 F_k ∧ Next ⇒ c'，不可推入的子句会暴露推入失败的前驱状态，IC3Syn 在此额外做一次「机会性阻塞」（先查已有子句，必要时至多一次 LLM 查询），若无准入子句则按普通非归纳处理，与标准 IC3 不同。验证后端分工明确：Apalache 承担所有符号见证查询（前沿查询、前驱查询、子句准入、子句推入），因其 SMT 编码可处理带量词的 TLA+ 状态空间而不必枚举状态；TLC 承担候选子句的批量具体筛选，用已累积的具体可达状态检查候选，被可达状态反驳的子句被丢弃，其反例作为诊断反馈引导后续生成；TLC 还按「排除坏状态数」对子句排序（覆盖多者优先、覆盖相同则短者优先），实现子句优先级机制。LLM 模块的提示包含：完整 TLA+ 规格、一批当前坏状态、从规格中提取并按变量重命名去重的量词模板、跨轮 clauseMemory（禁止重复）、逐子句的真/假观测记录（真者仅作结构指引并鼓励收紧、假者建议放松并把违规状态纳入其量化或取值空间）；要求输出 10–15 条自洽、无 primed 变量与时序算子的量化 TLA+ 子句（JSON 数组）。响应经 JSON 解析、规范化（自动修复「把模型常量误作量化绑定变量」等作用域错误）、SANY 语法检查，再交 TLC 筛选。关键设计选择是只让 LLM 提出针对特定坏状态、绑定特定帧层的单条阻塞子句，而非完整不变式；批量坏状态进一步增强泛化，使子句可一次性排除一族违规。

Result: 在 29 个分布式协议（共识、选主、锁服务、事务提交、防火墙、客户端-服务器、Paxos 变体与工业级 MLDR）上评测，超时限制 600 秒（pyv-paxos-epr 与 mldr 放宽至 2 小时，对所有工具一致），硬件为 Apple M4 Pro MacBook Pro。有效性：IC3Syn 求解全部 29 个协议，最难为 MLDR（4525 秒），且 29 个不变式全部经 TLAPS 证明在无界协议上归纳成立。基线对比：Endive 在 28 个共享协议上解出 24 个，且缺乏 IC3 式完备性回退；IC3PO 解出 26 个，但在 pyv-learning-switch、mldr、pyv-paxos-epr 三个最难用例上超时；SWISS 解出 17 个（8 超时、4 无解）；DistAI 最弱，多行报工具错误，pyv-sharded-kv-no-lost-keys 返回大量合取项仍无有效不变式。消融实验（RQ2）：移除 IC3 结构的直接 LLM 基线（Claude Opus 4.6）在同样 29 个基准上只解出 23 个、6 个超时（ex-simple-decentralized-lock、tla-twophase、i4-two-phase-commit、pyv-learning-switch、mldr、pyv-paxos-epr）；把模型换成更弱的 Gemini 3 Flash 但保留完整 IC3 控制器则解出 27 个，仅 mldr 与 pyv-paxos-epr 超时——值得注意的是更弱的 Gemini 3 Flash 配合 IC3 结构反而解决了 Claude Opus 4.6 直接合成失败的 tla-twophase，说明 IC3 分解、准入检查与后向前驱搜索提供的引导可补偿底层模型能力不足。案例研究 MLDR：发现 15 条强化合取（含安全性质共 16 条），分三类——单服务器良构性约束（8 条，如 configVersion ≥ 1、state=Primary ⇒ configTerm=currentTerm）、跨服务器关系（4 条，如配置唯一性 configVersion/configTerm 相同 ⇒ config 相同、仲裁重叠）、嵌套量词仲裁性质（3 条，如任意两服务器 s,t，s 的每个仲裁集 Q 中存在节点 n 满足 currentTerm[n] ≥ currentTerm[t] 或 IsNewerConfig(n,s)，阻止过期 primary 重建原选举仲裁集）；随后用 Apalache 迭代删除冗余子句，把 15 条化简为 7 条最小强化子句；MLDR 的 3000 余行 TLAPS 证明主要由 LLM 智能体（基于 Codex 自动化层）完成，无一行由人直接撰写；即便手工构造 38 个谓词的 Endive 池也未能解决 MLDR。动机示例中直接 LLM 合成 44 次失败，而 IC3 分解下 7 轮前沿阻塞仅需 2 次 LLM 调用，171 秒得到 11 条（最小化后 8 条）强化子句。局限：归纳性仅在有限实例上验证，依赖 TLAPS 补齐到无界情形；基准覆盖面可能不足以代表真实系统的多样结构。

Conclusion: IC3Syn 的核心洞见是：LLM 不必产出完整不变式，它们最适合作为结构化 IC3 架构内部的「假设生成器」——IC3 控制器把全局合成问题分解为逐状态的聚焦阻塞任务，通过帧准入与向前传播验证每一条提议子句，并在 LLM 失效时提供完备性回退。这种「LLM 负责协议级猜想、IC3 负责证明纪律」的分工使系统具备稳健性：即使较弱或不同训练的模型也能解决相当比例的基准，因为外围验证结构补偿了子句提议的不精确。总体而言，把 LLM 推理嵌入有原则的证明架构，可以让归纳不变式发现这一原本依赖专家数周至数月的工作变得可自动化，从而降低形式化验证门槛，使形式方法有望成为分布式系统开发的常规环节。论文同时给出清晰的分层图景：一旦获得候选不变式，后续 TLAPS 证明对 LLM 智能体已变得可行（MLDR 的 3000+ 行证明几乎全自动），而当前证明智能体尚无法自行推导所需归纳不变式——IC3Syn 恰可补上这一缺口，把已验证的不变式组织成候选引理交给 TLAPS 与证明智能体。后续工作方向包括：扩展到更大、更贴近工程实际的协议并优化 IC3 控制器与子句学习策略；探索调用验证技能与脚本的 LLM 智能体工作流（当前尝试因过早停止与重复工具调用导致高延迟、效率低于专用流水线）；以及自动化 TLAPS 证明义务的清偿（借助 LLM 引导的 TLA+ 证明自动化与基于智能体的证明生成）。

Abstract: Distributed protocols are notoriously difficult to verify correctly. Proving safety typically requires inductive invariants that both imply the desired property and are preserved by every protocol transition; yet inferring such invariants remains a major bottleneck: existing approaches either restrict the protocol models to a decidable fragment of first-order logic or demand expert-crafted templates.
  We present IC3Syn, a neuro-symbolic framework that synthesizes inductive invariants by executing an IC3-style process over TLA+ states with the assistance of Large Language Models (LLMs). At large, IC3Syn combines a symbolic IC3 controller, which decomposes invariant synthesis into focused blocking tasks and an LLM which provides protocol-level reasoning that IC3 alone lacks for TLA+ specifications. This integration enables a disciplined yet flexible search for invariants without imposing logical restrictions or requiring manual templates.
  We evaluate IC3Syn on 29 distributed protocols spanning consensus, reconfiguration and client-server systems, and compare it against Endive, IC3PO, SWISS and DistAI. IC3Syn discovers candidate invariants for all 29 protocols, including MongoLoglessDynamicRaft (MLDR), an industrial-scale Raft-based reconfiguration protocol for which none of the compared tools reports a solution, as well as one complex Paxos variant. In each case, the invariants synthesized on finite instances are shown in TLAPS to be inductive for the full unbounded protocol, thereby establishing safety.

</details>


### [222] [Multi-Agent Specification-based Metamorphic Testing of FMU-Based Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25101)
*Ashir Kulshreshtha,Abdullah Mughees,Gaadha Sudheerbabu,Tanwir Ahmad,Kristian Klemets,Dragos Truscan,Mikael Manngård*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出名为 AgenticMeta 的 LLM 驱动多智能体工作流，用于基于规范的 FMU 动态仿真模型变形测试（MT）：从功能与接口规范中抽取需求，生成并精炼以 Given-When-Then 表达的变形关系（MR），生成可执行变形测试用例，执行仿真并做输出级变异分析。在润滑油气冷却（LOC）系统 FMU 上的 10 次独立会话可行性评估显示：平均生成 15.80 条 MR、55.70 个测试用例，需求覆盖率 60.47%，测试通过率 74.10%，变异得分 0.56，单次完整运行约 937 秒，表明该自动化流程可行但覆盖与测试质量仍有明显局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FMU 作为 FMI 标准封装的仿真模型在工业协作中被广泛交换，但其封装特性带来两个验证难题：(1) 包内通常不含模型源码与内部实现，只能采用基于规范（黑盒）的测试技术；(2) 缺少显式期望输出（测试预言），常规测试方法难以适用，且传统上依赖领域专家手工测试。变形测试（MT）通过"变形关系"（MR）比较种子输入与变形输入的输出关系来判定结果，天然适合无预言系统。然而从规范中提取 MR 仍是手工且易错的过程；已有 LLM 生成 MR 的工作大多只产出候选 MR，缺少 MR 校验/精炼、测试生成、仿真执行与测试质量评估的端到端流程，且缺乏面向 FMU 的方法——FMU 的可测接口被 modelDescription.xml 暴露的变量严格限制，部分规范需求无法转换为有效输入-输出 MR。因此需要一个可追溯、面向 FMU 约束的自动化 MT 工作流，以降低人工工作量并提升测试生成质量。

Method: 架构采用 LangGraph 实现的 Python 分层工作流（编排层、规范与变量抽取层、MR 生成与精炼层、测试生成与验证层、测试执行层），每层持久化输入/输出/中间件以支持追溯与调试。整体为"hub-and-spoke"结构：由 Coordinator 节点作为中枢维护共享图状态（phase 字段驱动阶段路由）、统计信息并控制迭代与停止条件；前三个阶段由专用 LLM 智能体执行，最后的执行阶段由确定性工具完成。\n\n抽取阶段：Extractor Agent 将 PDF 功能规范转为 Markdown（提升后续解析精度），依据系统提示中的证据保全原则（逐字引用、表格为权威元数据来源、精确优先于推断、仅输出合法 JSON）抽取系统摘要、按属性分类的测试条件、以及输入输出间的因果关系；模型接口变量（名称、单位、因果性、可变性、取值范围等）由自定义 XML 解析脚本从 modelDescription.xml 抽取为 JSON。\n\nMR 生成阶段：MR Generator Agent 按配置的 mr_count 每轮提出候选 MR，任务提示要求输出唯一且不与此前（最多回溯 3 轮历史）重复的 MR，字段含 id、req_ids、scenario、given、when、then，并以严格 JSON schema 表达；优先级为行为类、绩效类等类别约束。MR 以 Given-When-Then（GWT，Gherkin 风格）结构化：Given 给出种子输入初始条件，When 给出变形输入关系（如 increase、STEP、RAMP 等模式），Then 给出输出验收准则（Eventually_Increases_than、Eventually_Decreases_than、Proportional_to、Equal_to、Settles_within 等比较/时序算子）。\n\nMR 精炼阶段：MR Refiner Agent 按事实正确性、类别一致性、约束合规性、因果有效性、可测试性等准则校验 MR，按修复规则修正缺失/错误信息，输出 refined MR，并附 feedback（增强可解释性）与 dropped（true/false，标记丢弃）；修复循环次数可配置，受限次数后终止。\n\n测试生成阶段：Test Generator Agent 为每条 MR 生成 test_cases_per_mr 个测试，依据抽取的初始条件赋值种子输入，用采样算法依据 When 中的输入关系生成 follow-up 输入具体值，同时考虑仿真起止时间与 I/O 约束；规则要求 STEP/RAMP 变化置于仿真时间窗前部（约 10–25%），设定点类输入保持不变。\n\n测试验证阶段：Test Validator Agent 按数据类型/边界检查、MR 模式类型、仿真时序约束等修复规则校验测试，输出 fixed、dropped 与 validation_summary 三态决策：完全有效（fixed=false, dropped=false）、可最小修复（fixed=true, dropped=false）、根本损坏不可安全修复（fixed=false, dropped=true）；有效/修复后的测试交由确定性实例化器生成各输入信号的时间序列（被变换的输入为时变序列，其余为常值向量）。\n\n执行与评估：使用 FMPy 仿真 FMU 执行测试并按 MR 判定通过/失败；由于无法访问 FMU 内部实现，变异分析直接在记录的输出时间序列上施加镜像（Mirror）、交叉（Crossover）、多项式（Polynomial）三类变异算子生成 mutant，再以输出 MR 判定是否杀死 mutant，得出变异得分。配置为 OpenAI GPT-5.4-mini，各智能体推理强度分级（抽取 none、测试生成 low、MR 生成与测试验证 medium、MR 精炼 high），5 轮迭代、每轮 5 条 MR、每 MR 5 个用例；实验在 Windows PC（i9-10900X、64 GB RAM）本地部署，10 次独立会话。

Result: RQ1（可行性）：10 次会话全部跑通抽取、MR 生成/精炼、测试生成/验证/实例化、仿真与变异分析全流程，架构可行。\n\nRQ2（抽取与生成能力）：平均生成 15.80 条 MR（平均丢弃 0.90 条、精炼 14.90 条），平均生成 55.70 个测试用例，需求覆盖率 60.47%（区间 35.29%–82.35%）；测试通过率平均 74.10%。领域专家人工复核认为 MR 有意义且与规范一致。覆盖率未达 100% 的原因：部分抽取需求是泛化的系统行为描述，不构成可直接操控的输入-输出关系；部分需求描述的输出行为无法由现有 FMU 输入直接影响，因而在精炼阶段被丢弃。直接可控输入与可观测输出之间的显式因果链对应的 MR 更稳定，依赖间接影响的 MR 更容易被精炼或移除。失败用例主要源于输出初始方向正确但在满足关系前稳定到不同值、或稳定值落在容差范围/设定点之外，与工作流中 ramp-up 取值有关，属假阳性。\n\nRQ3（测试质量）：平均变异得分 0.56（0.45–0.67），即 56% 的变异体被杀死。作者强调该指标需谨慎解读：变异施加于录制输出序列而非 FMU 实现，故反映的是 MR 对特定输出偏差的敏感性，而非对实现缺陷的完整故障检测能力；且通过率与变异得分不同步——通过率高意味着可变异用例更多，而某些变异算子对特定关系类型效果差，变异后输出仍满足关系，导致存活变异体增多、拉低得分。\n\nRQ4（运行时开销）：每次会话总执行时间平均 936.72 秒（抽取 84.64 s、MR 生成 649.55 s、测试生成 150.45 s、测试执行 52.08 s）；单位成本为每测试用例生成 2.72 s、每条 MR 生成与精炼 43.95 s、每测试用例执行 17.12 s。瓶颈集中在 LLM 驱动的 MR 生成与精炼阶段，因 Refiner 需高推理强度并同时比对结构化抽取结果与原始规范。\n\n有效性威胁：仅基于单一 LOC 案例（虽具连续输入输出的代表性，但控制逻辑/接口结构差异可能影响泛化）；工作流质量受规范文档质量制约；未在 modelDescription.xml 中描述的变量无法生成 MR。

Conclusion: 本文贡献在于把 LLM 多智能体、变形测试与 FMU 仿真验证整合为一个可追溯、面向 FMU 接口约束的端到端自动化工作流：需求抽取、MR 生成、MR 精炼、测试生成与验证、仿真执行及输出级变异分析全部由 AgenticMeta 统一编排，并以 GWT 模式承载 MR 以便被下游稳定处理。实验证明其能稳定、重复地产生与规范关联的 MR 和可执行变形测试（覆盖率 60.47%、通过率 74.10%、变异得分 56%），可显著降低人工测试工作量，支持动态仿真模型的系统化验证与确认。\n\n局限与未来工作：(1) 将确定性 Coordinator 改造为 LLM 智能体，使其能依据覆盖与质量反馈自适应决策——优先处理未覆盖需求、按需追加 MR 精炼、选择替代策略、判断何时继续或停止；(2) 强化对时序算子与容差阈值的验证，减少 ramp-up 引起的假阳性失败；(3) 设计更贴合所评估 MR 语义的变异算子，使基于变异的质量评估对 FMU 系统更稳健；(4) 优化性能——减少不必要的精炼调用、更有选择地优先未覆盖需求、缓存稳定的抽取产物、对低风险校验步骤采用更轻量的模型或推理设置；(5) 扩展到更多 FMU 案例以检验泛化性。

Abstract: In many industrial domains, the Functional Mock-up Interface (FMI) is used to exchange simulation models as Functional Mock-up Units (FMUs) across different partners using various modelling tools. This opens up the possibilities for simulation-based verification and validation using FMUs for ensuring reliable system behaviour. However, deriving effective test oracles for these simulation models remains challenging due to the absence of explicit expected outputs. This limits the applicability of conventional testing approaches, which require access to the internal workings of the systems. Metamorphic testing (MT) addresses this limitation by leveraging metamorphic relations (MRs), but extracting such relations from specifications remains largely a manual and error-prone process. To address this challenge, we propose an LLM-powered multi-agent workflow for specification-based metamorphic testing of FMU-based simulation models. The approach takes functional and interface specifications as input and orchestrates multiple agents to extract requirements and derive MRs. These MRs are expressed using Given-When-Then patterns to structure input conditions (Given), transformations (When), and expected output behaviours (Then). These relations are then used to generate metamorphic test cases, execute simulations, and evaluate output consistency across multiple sessions. We evaluate the approach on a Lube Oil Cooling system FMU, demonstrating its ability to automatically generate meaningful MRs and corresponding test cases. Preliminary results indicate that the proposed workflow can effectively support the systematic verification and validation of dynamic simulation models by reducing manual effort and improving test generation.

</details>


### [223] [Specification-Based Code-Text-Code Reengineering for LLM-Mediated Software Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25232)
*Oleg Grynets,Vasyl Lyashkevych,Arsen Dolichnyi,Roman Piznak,Taras Zelenyy,Volodymyr Morozov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于规格说明（specification-based）的 Code2Text2Code 重构框架：先将源代码转换为与语言无关的中立文本规格，再由 LLM 生成目标语言代码，以规避直接代码转换带来的语义漂移、行为变化、可追溯性丧失、目标实现不惯用和领域逻辑重建不完整等问题；并通过图形式化度量转换损失，实验验证了该框架作为"受控的规格驱动重工程"而非简单代码转换的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接 Code2Code 转换难以控制：可能保留表层语法却引入语义漂移与隐藏行为变更，导致可追溯性丧失、目标语言实现不惯用（non-idiomatic）、领域逻辑重建不完整。核心动机在于 LLM 参与的软件演化需要一个可验证、可追溯、以行为与意图为锚点的中间表示，而非语法层的机械翻译。

Method: 框架流程为：事实上下文抽取 → Code2Text 生成 → 源码与文本规格之间的迭代校验 → Text2Code 生成 → 目标代码校验 → 检索增强接地（retrieval-augmented grounding）→ 语义感知分块（semantic-aware chunking）→ 转换损失估计。知识表示层整合 AST 派生元数据、基于图的依赖结构、中立自然语言规格、技术文档、业务文档与架构级表示。损失估计采用图形式化，引入结构保持、反向兼容、接口稳定性与全图相似度（total graph similarity）等度量。实验涵盖多语言与多 SQL 方言构建的 Code2Text2Code 数据集、中间表示对比、检索评估、文档转换评估，以及基于 DSPy 的提示调优。

Result: 实验结果表明 Code2Text2Code 路径在中间表示质量、检索效果、文档转换保真度与提示调优（DSPy）上具备可量化优势；图形式化度量能够有效估计跨语言转换的结构与语义损失。总体结果支持将 Code2Text2Code 解释为受控的规格驱动重工程过程，而非简单的代码到代码翻译。

Conclusion: Code2Text2Code 是面向 LLM 介导软件演化的规格化重工程框架：以中性文本规格作为中介表示，解耦源语言语法与目标语言实现，通过多阶段校验与检索增强提升语义忠实度、可追溯性与目标实现的惯用性，并以图相似度形式化量化转换损失，为跨语言/跨方言迁移提供可控、可审计的工程路径。

Abstract: Direct Code2Code transformation remains challenging to control because it can preserve surface-level syntax while introducing semantic drift, hidden behavioral changes, loss of traceability, non-idiomatic target implementations, or incomplete reconstruction of domain logic. This paper proposes a specification-based Code2Text2Code reengineering framework for LLM-mediated software evolution. The central idea is to transform source code into a neutral textual specification that captures program behavior, identifiers, computational flow, conditions, side effects, data dependencies, and domain-specific intent without directly transferring the source language syntax. The proposed framework combines factual context extraction, Code2Text generation, iterative verification between source code and text specification, Text2Code generation, target code verification, retrieval-augmented grounding, and semantic-aware chunking, and transformation loss estimation. The knowledge representation layer integrates metadata derived from AST, graph-based dependency structures, neutral natural language specifications, technical documentation, business documentation, and architecture-level representations. The conducted experiments include a Code2Text2Code dataset built from multiple programming languages and SQL dialects, comparison of intermediate representations, retrieval evaluation, documentation transformation evaluation, and prompt tuning using DSPy. A graph formalization using structural preservation, reverse compatibility, interface stability, and total graph similarity is implemented to estimate transformation losses. The results support the interpretation of the Code2Text2Code approach not as a simple code transformation, but as a controlled specification-based reengineering process for LLM-mediated software evolution.

</details>


### [224] [PR-Aware Automated Unit Test Generation: Challenges and Opportunities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25285)
*Vahid Haratian,Atakan Akar,Berk Çakar,Eray Tüzün*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对"面向 PR（拉取请求）的自动化单元测试生成"这一被忽视的任务进行了首个系统评估：以 F2P（fail-to-pass，先在 base commit 失败、在 head commit 通过）作为衡量测试是否真正捕获 PR 变更的核心指标，在自建的 353 个 Java 8 PR 数据集（来自 8 个 Apache Commons 仓库）上对比 EvoSuite（搜索式）与 GPT-4o（单次提示 LLM）。结果显示 EvoSuite 明显更优（至少一个 F2P 的 PR 占比 36% vs 13%），但两者总体都很差——64% 的 PR 未能产出任何有意义的 F2P 测试；GPT-4o 的主要短板是 63% 的错误率（编译失败/幻觉），EvoSuite 错误率仅 2%。作者据此呼吁开发面向增量开发的高性能 PR 级测试生成工具，并看好带反馈闭环的智能体（agentic）方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动测试生成研究绝大多数面向"完整软件单元"（如整个类），并以行/分支覆盖率、变异分数等间接指标评估；而现代软件演进主要通过 PR 引入的小而具体的改动，测试目标应转为精准验证新增/修改行为（即 F2P 测试）。此前工作仅间接涉及该问题（从 issue 生成测试、回归/差分测试，如 WAFLGo、Cleverest），从未在 PR 粒度上以显式 F2P 目标系统研究，主流工具在此任务上的表现未知。同时，现有 PR 基准（SWE-Bench、Multi-SWE-Bench、defects4j、SWE-bench-java 等）以 Python 为主、Java 8 任务极少，与 EvoSuite 只可靠支持 Java 8 的硬性约束不兼容，因此必须自建数据集。作者希望揭示传统搜索式工具与 LLM 在该场景的真实能力差距。

Method: 研究围绕三个 RQ 组织。RQ1 评估 EvoSuite 的 F2P 有效性；RQ2 评估 GPT-4o 的编译率与 F2P 产出；RQ3 分析 PR 规模（修改文件数）对两者效果的影响。数据集：从 Apache 软件基金会筛选（≥10 名维护者、2019–2024 持续活跃、Maven 构建、Java 占比 >95%、单模块、标准 src/main/java 结构），人工确认 Java 8，最终 8 个仓库（commons-lang/io/collections/codec/imaging/csv/compress/text），每项目最多取 50 个已合并且改动 Java 文件的 PR，共 353 个 PR，并按修改文件数分为 1（200）、2–3（73）、4–5（27）、5+（53）四档。EvoSuite 流程：对 PR 涉及的每个类在 head 上生成测试（搜索预算 120s、DynaMOSA 默认算法），生成 *_ESTest 与 scaffolding 类放入测试目录，用 Maven/Surefire 仅运行该后缀测试，再在 base commit 上运行以判定 F2P；base 上编译失败（如调用了新增方法）也计为有效 F2P；单套件内个别失败用例被忽略，整体编译错误则整组标为 Error。GPT-4o 流程：单次提示（temperature 0.1，最大 64K tokens），逐文件提供 diff、完整源文件与已有测试类，排除 PR 自带的新/改测试以防泄露答案；提示工程经验包括 one-shot 示例、chain-of-thought、自校验均无效，最终有效改动为要求输出完整 import、测试类置于同包并加 _LLMTest 后缀、只输出代码不含自然语言描述、脚本自动修正包名/类名；尝试多次生成、列表提供资源文件、禁用外部文件、Mockito mock 等策略均无改善。结果分类为 Error / No F2P / F2P 三类，并额外计算剔除 Error 后的 F2P 比例。

Result: EvoSuite：编译/可运行率 98%（仅 2% 错误），62% 的 PR 为 "No F2P"，36% 至少含一个 F2P（剔除错误后 37%）；commons-lang 因文件巨大而 No F2P 高达 91%。GPT-4o：63% 为 Error（编译失败、幻觉依赖、类型/可见性不匹配，commons-imaging 尤甚），13% 产出 F2P，24% 为 No F2P，剔除错误后 F2P 为 34%，略低于 EvoSuite。规模效应（RQ3）：EvoSuite 随文件数增加 F2P 比例先升后降（4–5 个文件后回落）；GPT-4o 则文件数越多编译错误越多、F2P 比率波动，整体性能下降。5+ 文件的 PR 多为大功能实现或跨文件重构/重命名，作者认为自动测试生成在该类 PR 上价值有限。

Conclusion: 面向 PR 的测试生成既不能依赖传统搜索式方法（EvoSuite 目标函数与整文件覆盖不匹配），也不能依赖单次提示 LLM（幻觉与编译错误率过高）；64% 的 PR 无法被现有工具以 F2P 方式覆盖。作者主张 LLM 天然适合 PR 粒度（可被指示聚焦修改行、受影响方法与邻近测试），但必须引入反馈驱动的智能体式工作流——迭代编译执行、读取编译器与运行时信号、修复或重定向测试候选直至达成 F2P，并配以 F2P 过滤/计数工具（如 YATE、TELPA、TestSpark、TestForge、OpenHands/SWE-Agent 等所示）。另一方向是深入分析 PR 特征（文件数、文件大小、方法大小、被修改文件的重要性）与测试生成可靠性的关系，以指导工具改进与适用性判断。作者亦指出数据清洗、基线配置、训练数据泄漏与 PR 粒度分布不均衡等效度威胁。

Abstract: Automated test generation has a substantial body of work, yet most studies focus on generating tests for complete software units, such as classes, and rely on metrics such as code coverage for assessment. In contrast, modern software development primarily evolves through small, targeted changes introduced in pull requests (PRs). Despite this, the crucial task of generating tests specifically for these PRs has been overlooked, and the performance of state-of-the-art tools for this purpose remains unknown.
  This study evaluates two distinct approaches for PR-aware test generation: EvoSuite, a leading search-based tool, and GPT-4o, one of the widely used large language models (LLMs). To measure their effectiveness at validating PR-specific changes, we assess their ability to generate fail-to-pass (F2P) test cases, meaning tests that fail on the code before the change and pass on the code after the change.
  Our evaluation shows that EvoSuite outperformed GPT-4o, producing at least one F2P test for a significantly higher percentage of PRs (36 percent vs. 13 percent). The performance of GPT-4o was significantly hampered by a high rate of compilation errors (63 percent), whereas only 2 percent of EvoSuite's generated tests failed to run. Despite EvoSuite's relative success, our findings indicate that both tools are largely ineffective for this task, as they failed to generate any meaningful change-capturing tests for the large majority of the PRs (64 percent).
  Although both generators could not achieve a high F2P ratio in our evaluation, and EvoSuite outperformed GPT-4o, we believe that agentic code generation methods may have significant potential for this task. Ultimately, our work highlights a critical gap in tooling and calls for the development of high-performance test generators tailored to the incremental nature of modern software development.

</details>


### [225] [Names Are All You Need: Effective and Safe Regression Test Selection for Python](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25356)
*You Wang,Michael Pradel,Zhongxin Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Regression test selection reduces the cost of regression testing by executing only those tests affected by a code change. Despite extensive study of RTS in statically typed languages, achieving effective and safe RTS in Python is challenging. Python's dynamic typing makes precise call-graph construction difficult, which can cause call-graph-based RTS to miss affected tests. Python's eager importing mechanism, in contrast, renders file-level dependency analysis overly conservative. This paper presents NameRTS, the first Python RTS approach based on fine-grained dependency analysis. NameRTS models a Python program as a bipartite graph of code element nodes and name nodes, with edges capturing definitions and references. RTS is formulated as a reachability problem on this graph: a test is selected if any modified code element is reachable from the names used in that test. This design avoids call-graph construction, enabling a conservative analysis amenable to safety. To control dependency cascades introduced by coarse name matching, NameRTS applies two pruning strategies that leverage prior test executions and context information to refine name matching. To evaluate NameRTS, we construct the first Python RTS dataset with a ground truth indicating which test files are affected by each commit. We compare NameRTS with the best-performing baseline, BabelRTS, an RTS technique based on coarse file-level dependencies. On this benchmark, NameRTS skips 69.90% of test files on average, outperforming BabelRTS by 146.5%. It also reduces end-to-end testing time by 45.59%, yielding a 107.7% improvement over BabelRTS. In terms of safety, NameRTS selects all affected tests for 99.6% of commits, with only rare misses in exceptional cases. In contrast, BabelRTS is safe for 76.6% of commits. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of NameRTS, paving the way for more efficient regression testing in Python.

Abstract: Regression test selection reduces the cost of regression testing by executing only those tests affected by a code change. Despite extensive study of RTS in statically typed languages, achieving effective and safe RTS in Python is challenging. Python's dynamic typing makes precise call-graph construction difficult, which can cause call-graph-based RTS to miss affected tests. Python's eager importing mechanism, in contrast, renders file-level dependency analysis overly conservative. This paper presents NameRTS, the first Python RTS approach based on fine-grained dependency analysis. NameRTS models a Python program as a bipartite graph of code element nodes and name nodes, with edges capturing definitions and references. RTS is formulated as a reachability problem on this graph: a test is selected if any modified code element is reachable from the names used in that test. This design avoids call-graph construction, enabling a conservative analysis amenable to safety. To control dependency cascades introduced by coarse name matching, NameRTS applies two pruning strategies that leverage prior test executions and context information to refine name matching. To evaluate NameRTS, we construct the first Python RTS dataset with a ground truth indicating which test files are affected by each commit. We compare NameRTS with the best-performing baseline, BabelRTS, an RTS technique based on coarse file-level dependencies. On this benchmark, NameRTS skips 69.90% of test files on average, outperforming BabelRTS by 146.5%. It also reduces end-to-end testing time by 45.59%, yielding a 107.7% improvement over BabelRTS. In terms of safety, NameRTS selects all affected tests for 99.6% of commits, with only rare misses in exceptional cases. In contrast, BabelRTS is safe for 76.6% of commits. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of NameRTS, paving the way for more efficient regression testing in Python.

</details>


### [226] [Leveraging Language Models for Log Statement Generation in Multilingual Scenarios: How Far Are We?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25374)
*Kazuki Kusama,Honglin Shu,Masanari Kondo,Yasutaka Kamei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Log statements capture critical information for software maintenance activities such as testing, debugging, and failure analysis. Because of this importance, developers must carefully design log statements, which requires significant effort. To support developers, various end-to-end automated log statement generation approaches have been proposed, whereas these approaches have mainly been evaluated within a single programming language environment and their effectiveness in multilingual environments remains underexplored. In this paper, we therefore comparatively evaluate three state-of-the-art log statement generation approaches and five large language models (LLMs) across multiple programming languages. For this purpose, we constructed a multilingual benchmark comprising 150,000 instances across five programming languages. Our empirical results demonstrate that UniLog, a state-of-the-art approach, achieves the best overall performance, maintaining high effectiveness even in multilingual environments. We also observe substantial variance in the difficulty of log generation across languages: Python presents a greater challenge, whereas JavaScript yields comparatively better performance. Detailed analysis reveals that these disparities stem from variations in log insertion distributions and language-specific logging idioms. Our findings indicate that simply scaling model size or the volume of training data is insufficient for multilingual log generation; rather, designing approaches tailored to the specific characteristics of target languages is crucial. These findings suggest that future automated logging techniques should explicitly account for language-specific logging characteristics to achieve robust performance in multilingual software development environments.

### [227] [Temporal Modeling of Change History for Black-Box Test Suite Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25441)
*Kamruzzaman Asif,Md. Siam,Kazi Sakib*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Test Suite Minimization (TSM) reduces the size of test suites while preserving their fault detection capability. In black-box TSM, reduction is performed without relying on production-code instrumentation. While several black-box TSM approaches have explored metrics like test logs or test similarity, these often suffer from scalability and efficiency issues. Recently, change history has been explored as a lightweight and scalable indicator for guiding black-box TSM. However, existing approaches treat historical modifications uniformly, ignoring the temporal dynamics of software evolution where recently modified code tends to be more fault-prone. To address this limitation, we introduce temporal modeling into black-box TSM and propose Temporal Risk-driven Test Suite Minimization (TRTM). TRTM extracts modification history from version-control metadata and applies exponential temporal attenuation to weight changes based on recency, producing time-weighted class-level risk scores that reflect fault-proneness. Next, it determines dependencies between test cases and production classes by constructing static call graphs derived solely from test code, preserving the black-box setting. The risk scores of the classes exercised by each test case are then aggregated using statistical measures such as Average and Geometric Mean to compute a risk score for the test case. Finally, test cases with the highest risk scores are selected to construct the reduced suite. Evaluation on a large dataset containing 14 projects with 631 versions shows that TRTM consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline, achieving a mean Accuracy of 0.72 (vs. 0.66) and Fault Detection Rate (FDR) of 0.75 (vs. 0.69), while also reducing execution time.

### [228] [A Heuristic Approach to Localize CSS Properties for Responsive Layout Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25476)
*Tasmia Zerin,B M Mainul Hossain,Kazi Sakib*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Responsive Layout Failures (RLFs) typically arise from CSS properties that hinder proper layout behavior in different screen sizes. To find an accurate and effective solution for repairing RLFs, localization of those problematic properties is necessary. However, existing approaches only detect RLFs and apply broad CSS patches for them. The patches alter the entire layout without localizing the root cause of failure. To address this gap, we propose a heuristic approach to identify the specific CSS properties that developers would typically localize manually. The approach first detects the RLFs existing in a webpage and their affected elements. Next, it localizes the nearby HTML elements using RLF direction and relative alignment of the elements present in the RLF region. The involved CSS properties of those elements are then identified using a ranked search set of CSS properties, created by analyzing Quora and Stack Overflow queries. Finally, elements and their corresponding property pairs are ranked based on their impact on RLFs. We have implemented this approach into a tool called {\normalfont \textsc{LocaliCSS}} and evaluated it on a set of webpages using Top N Rank, MRR and P@K metrics. The tool achieved localization accuracy ranging from 45.2% (Top-1) to 92.86% (Top-7), with an MRR of 76% and a P@3 of 77.13%. Additionally, experienced front-end engineers manually localized the RLFs as part of our evaluation. Their preferred CSS properties matched the suggestions from our approach in 42.86% of cases for Top-1 rankings and up to 90.48% for Top-7 rankings.

### [229] [A Tertiary Review of Large Language Model-Based Code Generating Tasks: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25536)
*Muslim Chochlov,Michael English,Jim Buckley*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Context. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to code-generating tasks (CGTs) in software engineering. While reported results are promising, the broader effects of such application and their integration into real-world development remain insufficiently understood with existing tertiary studies provide little in this area. Objective. This tertiary study consolidates secondary evidence on LLM-based CGTs, synthesizing the publication landscape, effects, scenarios, integration challenges, and future research directions. Method. Following systematic review guidelines, we searched in related digital libraries, complemented by backward-and-forward snowballing and screening step. Study quality was assessed and extraction reliability was audited with inter-rater agreement statistics. Evidence was synthesized using SWEBOK knowledge areas and the HELM framework. Results. We identify 30 secondary studies published between 2017-2025, with rapid growth since 2023. Accuracy seems strong on benchmarks but weakly supported for real-world generalization; robustness is fragile across tasks and configurations; efficiency constraints are pervasive; toxicity and bias are under-reported. Dominant challenges concern economic feasibility, evaluation validity, and socio-technical integration. Future directions suggest domain-aware model improvement and the need for holistic, standardized evaluation. Conclusion. LLM-based CGTs represent a fast-maturing yet unevenly evaluated research area, highlighting the need for domain-aware model improvements and holistic, standardized evaluation, addressing efficiency and associated costs.

### [230] [Meta-Engineering Harnesses for AI-Native Software Production: A Contract-Driven Adversarial Verification Architecture with Early Deployment Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25665)
*Satadru Sengupta,Tamunokorite Briggs,Ivan Myshakivskyi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AI-native software development is often evaluated at the level of individual models, prompts, or generated artifacts. This framing is insufficient for production environments where software must be continuously produced, verified, deployed, maintained, and adapted across many operational contexts and long time horizons.
  We present a meta-engineering harness: a software-production architecture that transforms operational and product feature requirements into explicit contracts, routes work through role-specialized AI agents, performs independent and adversarial verification, and continuously improves itself through structured failure classification and outer-loop calibration.
  The harness is designed for settings in which software delivery is not a one-time project but an ongoing operating function. In our motivating application, CTO-as-a-service for small service firms, the system manages websites, booking flows, payment systems, backoffice workflow automations, and AI-agent interfaces as continuously evolving technical infrastructure rather than one-off deliverables.
  We describe the layered architecture, including two-pass contract compilation, persistent markdown memory with specialization records, attention-based and independence-based verifications, a four-way failure arbiter, and outer-loop calibration. We report results from an early production deployment spanning 17 features over several weeks, including a detailed in-app payments case study that revealed contract incompleteness and verification-boundary issues. These observations directly drove targeted improvements to the harness.
  The contribution is an implemented, measurable, and extensible verification architecture for making AI-native service-as-a-software production reliable, auditable, and improvable over time.

### [231] [How Agentic AI Coding Assistants Become the Attacker's Shell](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25871)
*Yue Liu,Yanjie Zhao,Yunbo Lyu,Ting Zhang,Haoyu Wang,David Lo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Agentic AI coding assistants can edit files, run commands, and access the internet on behalf of developers. However, their reliance on unvetted external artifacts introduces a new attack vector. Hidden instructions in external artifacts can hijack these assistants, turning them into an attacker's shell to run unauthorized commands. In this article, we examine how these prompt injection attacks work, measure their prevalence, discuss the limitations and challenges of current defenses, and suggest future research directions.

### [232] [From Early Adoption to Sustained Use: Understanding GenAI Usage Among Software Developers in Italian SMEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25973)
*Fabio Calefato,Alexandra Pajonk,Victoria Jackson,Guilherme Vaz Pereira,Rafael Prikladnicki,Filippo Lanubile*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Generative AI tools are rapidly transforming software development practice, prompting unprecedented research interest. However, existing studies have predominantly examined initial adoption rather than sustained use. Understanding what drives developers to continue using these tools after initial adoption remains underexplored, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises where resource constraints shape technology decisions differently than in large organisations. This study investigates factors associated with developers' intentions to continue using GenAI tools, adapting the UTAUT2 framework to post-adoption professional contexts. We employed a two-phase mixed-methods design. Phase 1 comprised a six-month longitudinal pilot study at an Italian software company combining surveys and interviews with 17 developers to explore how perceptions of GenAI evolve as experience accumulates. These insights informed a structural model tested in Phase 2 through a cross-sectional survey of 154 developers across Italian SMEs, analysed using PLS-SEM. The model explained substantial variance in continued use intention (R2 = 0.647), with individual-level perceptions, particularly around productivity, enjoyment, and ease of use, driving sustained adoption, whereas social and organisational factors played no significant role. These findings suggest that, for GenAI tools, post-adoption behaviour differs from initial adoption patterns: in voluntary professional contexts, sustained use is driven primarily by individual-level factors rather than by social and organisational support.
