### [391] [Explore Before You Solve: The Speed--Depth Trade-off in Epistemic Agents for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25931)
*Liew Keong Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: We systematically investigate all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games and find that every one is reachable through non-intelligent strategies: 10 in a single blind step, 5 after one probing action, 1 via repeated ACTION1 presses, 1 via diverse exploration, and 8 via single repeated actions with sufficient budget (50-200 steps). A library-level null-coordinate vulnerability additionally bypasses 18 games in 1 step. This benchmark critique implies the public evaluation set cannot discriminate intelligent exploration from trivial heuristics - the private 55-game evaluation is the only genuine intelligence test. Against this backdrop, we present AERA (Adaptive Epistemic Reasoning Agent), a three-phase (EXPLORE / VERIFY / PLAN) agent achieving RHAE=0.2116 (4/25 solved) on these 25 games with Qwen2.5-0.5B, while random and no-explore baselines score 0.0000. We formalise AERA through a Speed--Depth trade-off framework: under a convexity assumption (proved for a class of environments in the Appendix), RHAE's quadratic form emerges as a second-order penalty for deviating from the Pareto frontier between action efficiency and information gain. Contributions: (i) a benchmark validity analysis showing that current interactive reasoning benchmarks fail to measure the exploration they claim to require, and (ii) the EXPLORE-before-PLAN framework and model-capability x exploration interaction. The linked code track entry achieves RHAE=0.30 on the full 55-game private evaluation. Code: CC0.

### [392] [LECTOR: Joint Optimization of Scientific Reasoning Graphs and Introduction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25964)
*Jiabei Xiao,Yizhou Wang,Chen Tang,Pengze Li,Wanli Ouyang,Shixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI Scientists have shown promising progress across multiple stages of the research pipeline, among which automatic scientific paper writing remains a formidable challenge. The Introduction writing is especially challenging, which demands not only linguistic fluency, but logical soundness and verifiable faithfulness. Most AI-assisted methods treat the task as text generation instead of reasoning and structuring, leading to severe drawbacks, e.g., hallucinating citations. To address this, we first formulate the Content-Conditional Introduction Generation (CCIG) task, which requires grounding the Introduction in the paper's core evidence. We then propose LECTOR, a novel Logic-Expression Co-Reinforcement Learning framework that can strictly follow the scientist's logic, add high-quality citations and keep structured expressions. LECTOR first constructs a logic-reasoning graph from the paper's main body to serve as a verifiable logical blueprint. Subsequently, it employs a Logic-Expression Co-Rewarding mechanism to jointly optimize for both the graph's structural fidelity and the final narrative's quality. We conduct a dataset from Nature Communications papers to assess our method. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements in both logic fidelity and Introduction generation quality metrics, e.g., Graph Quality (+26.7%), Citation Quality (+8.6%), and Paper Consistency (+3.3%). Code and data are available at https://github.com/Xiao-Youth/LECTOR.

### [393] [Neural Scalable Symbolic Search Framework for Complex Logical Queries with Multiple Free Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25985)
*Weizhi Fei,Hang Yin,Zihao Wang,Shukai Zhao,Wei Zhang,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Complex Query Answering (CQA) is a fundamental knowledge representation and reasoning task over incomplete knowledge graphs (KGs). Answering existential first-order queries with $k$ free variables (i.e., $\text{EFO}_k$ queries) is a crucial yet challenging problem, as it requires ranking answer tuples in $\mathcal{E}^k$, where $\mathcal{E}$ denotes the entity set of a KG. This quickly becomes intractable as $k$ grows. Consequently, existing benchmarks and methods rely on marginal rankings over individual variables; however, marginal rankings are a poor proxy for the true joint ranking of tuples. Building on neural symbolic search for $\text{EFO}_1$ queries, we propose Neural Scalable Symbolic Search (NS3), a budgeted framework that approximates joint ranking without enumerating $\mathcal{E}^k$. NS3 (i) answers marginalized sub-queries to obtain necessary candidate sets, (ii) merges multiple free variables into hypernodes whose domains are pruned and controlled by a dynamic budget $B$, and (iii) progressively reduces an $\text{EFO}_k$ query to an $\text{EFO}_{k-1}$ query over a budgeted reduced domain. Across three standard KG datasets, NS3 substantially improves joint ranking performance while retaining strong marginal accuracy. We further release a joint-ranking benchmark that extends existing $\text{EFO}_1$ datasets to $k=3$, enabling systematic evaluation of multi-variable queries. Our code is provided in https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/NS3_KDD2026.

### [394] [CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal Discovery Toward AI Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26029)
*Junlin Yang,Dylan Zhang,Xiangchen Song,Qirun Dai,Xiao Liu,Yuen Chen,Aniket Vashishtha,Jing Shi,Chenhao Tan,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: We introduce CausaLab, a scalable environment for evaluating interactive causal discovery by LLM agents. Unlike prior evaluations, CausaLab evaluates both whether an agent can solve a problem using causal evidence and whether its answer is supported by a correct hypothesis about the underlying causal mechanism. Each episode places an agent in a synthetic laboratory: it receives prior measurement records, intervenes on a manipulator crystal, and predicts the resonance frequency of a held-out reactor crystal governed by the same mechanism. The hidden data-generating process is a randomly sampled structural causal model (SCM), so success requires recovering both a causal graph and structural equations rather than recalling prior knowledge. CausaLab also includes a domain-specific language that records the agent's evolving SCM hypothesis, making trajectories inspectable and comparable with ground truth. Experiments show a persistent gap between prediction and mechanism recovery: in the purely observational 6-node setting, GPT-5.2-high reaches 92% task accuracy but only 0.471 all-edge $F_1$. This observation further motivates our exploration of different interaction strategies: Mixed observation--intervention strategies improve structural fidelity: in the mixed 6-node setting, GPT-5.2-high achieves 80% on both task accuracy and all-edge $F_1$. Yet even strong agents struggle to design informative interventions, as pure intervention strategies perform poorly on both task accuracy and all-edge $F_1$. We identify premature stopping as a major weakness of agents, and show that asking the model to verify the consistency between its hypothesis and past data can help mitigate this issue. CausaLab therefore separates predictive success from causal understanding and exposes current LLM agents' limits as experimental causal reasoners.

### [395] [CITYREP: A Unified Benchmark for Urban Representations Across Cities, Tasks, and Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26036)
*Junyuan Liu,Xinglei Wang,Zichao Zeng,Jiazhuang Feng,Quan Qin,Ilya Ilyankou,Guangsheng Dong,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Urban representation learning encodes complex urban environments into general-purpose embeddings for diverse downstream tasks and emerging urban foundation models. However, current evaluations are limited, typically focusing on one or two cities and tasks and relying on random splits that introduce spatial leakage, leading to inflated performance and weak support for cross-location generalization and fair comparison. To address this, we propose CityRep, a unified benchmark that evaluates urban representations across data modalities, cities, and tasks using spatially structured splits. CityRep consists of three key components: (1) a spatial unit-agnostic evaluation framework that supports heterogeneous urban representations through a standardized alignment module; (2) a unified evaluation protocol using block-based spatial splits to mitigate spatial leakage and enable rigorous model comparison; and (3) an extensible multi-city, multi-task benchmark suite spanning 8 cities and 8 tasks across regression, classification, and distribution prediction. We evaluate 11 representative urban representation models. Results show that performance is highly sensitive to the split protocol, with random splits inflating scores and altering model rankings. We also observe substantial variability across cities and tasks, underscoring the need for generalization-aware evaluation. CityRep is released as a reproducible benchmark with datasets, evaluation pipelines, and diagnostic tools to facilitate fair comparison and support future research in urban representation learning towards urban foundation models.

### [396] [L2IR: Revealing Latent Intent in Graph Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26040)
*Jinsheng Guo,Zhenhao Weng,Yibo Liu,Yan Qiao,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Graph fraud detection has long depended on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to propagate and aggregate information across relational data. A critical obstacle in practice, however, is that fraudsters frequently disguise themselves by forging numerous connections with benign users, causing fraud signals to be progressively diluted during neighborhood aggregation and undermining detection reliability. While recent efforts have used Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide rich semantic cues for fraud detection, the underlying intent behind suspicious connections remains insufficiently explored. Compounding this issue, the scarcity of annotated fraud samples makes it difficult to train detectors that remain robust under heavy camouflage. To address these gaps, we propose L2IR, an LLM-driven Latent Intent Revealing framework for graph fraud detection. By uncovering latent intent from both user behaviors and suspicious connections, L2IR extracts intent-aware representations from raw behavioral traces and reasons about the true purpose behind individual connections, effectively distinguishing supportive links from misleading ones. It further incorporates adaptive self-training to enhance robustness under limited supervision. Evaluations on two real-world datasets characterized by pervasive camouflage demonstrate that L2IR surpasses strong baselines and can function as a plug-in enhancement for a range of GNN-based detectors, improving AUPRC by up to 8.27%.

While recent efforts have used Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide rich semantic cues for fraud detection, the underlying intent behind suspicious connections remains insufficiently explored. Compounding this issue, the scarcity of annotated fraud samples makes it difficult to train detectors that remain robust under heavy camouflage. To address these gaps, we propose L2IR, an LLM-driven Latent Intent Revealing framework for graph fraud detection. By uncovering latent intent from both user behaviors and suspicious connections, L2IR extracts intent-aware representations from raw behavioral traces and reasons about the true purpose behind individual connections, effectively distinguishing supportive links from misleading ones. It further incorporates adaptive self-training to enhance robustness under limited supervision. Evaluations on two real-world datasets characterized by pervasive camouflage demonstrate that L2IR surpasses strong baselines and can function as a plug-in enhancement for a range of GNN-based detectors, improving AUPRC by up to 8.27%.

</details>


### [397] [Retrying vs Resampling in AI Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26047)
*James Lucassen,Adam Kaufman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI coding scaffolds like Claude Code and Codex use \textit{retrying}: blocking actions flagged as risky and continuing the trajectory. We study retrying from an AI control perspective, which treats the model as potentially adversarial. We find that while retrying reduces honest suspicion scores, the untrusted model can exploit monitor rationale to construct sneakier attacks, negating safety gains. We also study \textit{resampling}: drawing multiple samples from the same context, which does not leak exploitable information. We disentangle design choices that previous work on resampling had bundled together. In BashArena, with Claude Opus 4.6 as the untrusted model and MiMo-V2-Flash as the trusted monitor, drawing five samples per step and auditing on the maximum suspicion score raises safety from 61\% to 71\% at a 0.3\% audit budget, at no cost to usefulness. Selectively resampling only the steps that look suspicious on the first draw recovers 6.2 percentage points of the gain while drawing only 10\% as many extra samples. Two of our findings in this setting contradict earlier work on resampling. The first is that auditing based on the maximum across resampled suspicion scores outperforms using the minimum, which is the opposite of what Ctrl-Z found. The second is that executing the least suspicious sample, which is the central mechanism in earlier defer-to-resample protocols, gives only a small empirical safety gain in our setting (+3.9 pp, with the confidence interval overlapping zero).

### [398] [VeriTrace: Evolving Mental Models for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26081)
*Haolang Zhao,Yunbo Long,Lukas Beckenbauer,Alexandra Brintrup*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Deep research agents face vast, interdependent, and pervasively uncertain information. Existing systems explore what evolving intermediate representations should look like, but leave their evolution to the LLM's implicit reasoning. Without explicit regulation, the intermediate layer is easily contaminated by mixed-quality information and propagates errors along its dependencies, so model scale often ends up substituting for absent regulation. We argue that an agent's mental model should instead evolve through explicit feedback that continuously aligns task understanding with reality, and identify three regulatory loops: interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision. We realise this in VeriTrace, a cognitive-graph framework that explicitly implements the three loops. Using matched Qwen3.5-27B backbones, VeriTrace improves over the strongest matched baseline by 4.22 pp on DeepResearch Bench (DRB) Insight (1.49 pp Overall) and by 5.9 pp Overall win rate on DeepConsult. With Config-DeepSeek, it achieves the strongest reproducible open-source result on DRB.

### [399] [Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26086)
*Yusong Lin,Xinyuan Liang,Haiyang Wang,Qipeng Gu,Siqi Cheng,Jiangui Chen,Shuzhe Wu,Feiyang Pan,Lue Fan,Sanyuan Zhao,Dandan Tu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Large language model agents are increasingly envisioned as always-on personal assistants with access to anything relevant in the user's digital world. Yet current systems operate over only narrow slices of that world, limiting context-sensitive reasoning and effective assistance. Existing benchmarks similarly provide only partial user state and therefore fail to capture performance in such a broad, always-on setting. To address this gap, we introduce Claw-Anything, a benchmark that expands agent context along three dimensions: long-horizon activity histories, interdependent backend services, and integrated GUI and CLI interaction across multiple devices. To instantiate this setting, we simulate months of user activity through multi-round event injection, producing complex world states and realistic noise, including irrelevant events and conflicting signals. Agents must reason over rich contextual environments while remaining robust to such noise. This expanded scope also enables the evaluation of proactive assistance, requiring agents to anticipate user needs and deliver timely recommendations. Experiments show that GPT-5.5 achieves only 34.5% pass@1, substantially below prior benchmarks, underscoring a gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of always-on personal assistance. Alongside the benchmark, we release an automated data-generation pipeline that yields 2,000 training environments and improves the base model by 23.7%, demonstrating its utility of scalable data infrastructure.

### [400] [From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26112)
*Shangding Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper studies the next major bottleneck in agentic AI as system scaling, not only model scaling: the design of auditable, persistent, modular, and verifiable architectures around foundation models. We refer to this shift as scaling the harness: treating the structured execution layer around a foundation model as a first-class object of design, evaluation, and optimization. Although recent large language models enable agents to use tools, retrieve information, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon workflows, evaluation remains largely model-centric, often reducing agents to final-task success while treating memory, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, verification, and governance as secondary implementation details. This framing is increasingly inadequate because agent performance emerges from the interaction among the foundation model, memory substrate, context constructor, skill-routing layer, orchestration loop, and verification-and-governance layer. Together, these components form the agent harness, which translates model capability into long-horizon agent behavior. We study scaling the harness through three core bottlenecks: context governance, trustworthy memory, and dynamic skill routing, together with the orchestration and governance mechanisms that coordinate and constrain them. We further outline a research agenda for harness-level benchmarks that go beyond one-shot task success to measure trajectory quality, memory hygiene, context efficiency, communication fidelity, verification cost, and safe evolution over time. To make the discussion concrete, we develop CheetahClaws: https://github.com/SafeRL-Lab/cheetahclaws, a Python-native reference harness, and compare it with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Our main claim is that future progress in agentic AI will depend as much on system design as on stronger foundation models.

### [401] [MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26114)
*Dingbang Wu,Rui Hao,Haiyang Wang,Shuzhe Wu,Han Xiao,Zhenghong Li,Bojiang Zhou,Zheng Ju,Zichen Liu,Lue Fan,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.

### [402] [Efficient Uniform Sampling of Surjections via their Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24068)
*Arnaud Carayol,Pablo Rotondo*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了从[n]到[k]的随机满射的高效采样问题。通过引入"profile"（记录每个预像大小的出现次数）这一核心概念，将复杂采样问题简化，并证明profile结构是亚线性的（≤√(2n)条目）。在此基础上，文章设计了基于精确尺寸Boltzmann采样器的完整算法集，覆盖全部参数空间，在预期输出大小上达到最优。该工作还解决了随机映射profile采样的开放问题，具有理论与实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机满射采样在实际应用中具有重要意义，但现有方法通常假设n/k为常数，难以处理任意规模参数。该文旨在为所有n≥k提供均匀保证的高效采样算法。

Method: 1) 引入profile（轮廓）结构，将满射采样问题规约到profile采样；2) 采用精确尺寸Boltzmann采样器（标准拒绝采样）；3) 将参数空间划分为三个区域，在每个区域分别优化拒绝率和采样轮次成本。

Result: 1) 证明profile结构捕获了满射采样的全部复杂性，是至多√(2n)个条目的亚线性结构；2) 建立了直接采样随机满射profile的完整算法集；3) 回答了Devroye和Los (2025)的公开问题：当k > n/logn时提供了随机映射profile的最优算法。

Conclusion: 提出了一套完整的、实用的随机满射采样算法，在预期输出大小上最优（至多有对数因子），覆盖全部参数空间，并推广至随机映射的profile采样问题。

Abstract: In this article, we develop efficient sampling algorithms for random surjections from $[n]$ to $[k]$ for all $n \geq k$. We make no assumption about $n$ and $k$. In particular, we do not make the common assumption that the ratio $\frac{n}{k}$ is constant. All our guarantees are uniform in $n$ and $k$.
  Our first insight is that all the complexity in sampling random surjections is captured by sampling a smaller structure which we call the \emph{profile} of the surjection. More precisely, the profile associates to each occurring preimage size $s$ the number of preimages of size $s$. Using standard techniques, we show that the problem of sampling surjections reduces to sampling the profile with the induced distribution. This is partly explained by the fact that profiles are always sublinear, with at most $\sqrt{2n}$ entries in the worst case.
  We provide a complete set of algorithms to directly sample the \emph{profile} of a random surjection with the induced distribution, covering the full parameter space. These algorithms are shown to be optimal up to logarithmic factors in the expected size of the output. Our algorithms are based on exact-size Boltzmann samplers, which are standard rejection-based samplers. We partition the parameter space into three main regions. In each region, we optimize both the rejection rate and the cost of each sampling round.
  Profiles capture a number of relevant statistics of random surjections and might be of independent interest. In a related context, profiles have been recently studied by Devroye et al. for random mappings. As a spin-off result, we answer an open question from Devroye and Los '25 by providing an optimal algorithm also for the profiles of a random mapping when $k > n/\log n$.
  The results of this article are not only of theoretical interest but lead to samplers implementable in practice.

</details>


### [403] [A Tight Bound on Localization of Electrical Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24130)
*Ori Gurel-Gurevich,Asaf Nachmias,Sushant Sachdeva*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Establishes optimal O(log n) bounds for electric current norms on graphs, improving previous O(log² n) results by a factor of log n. Bounds are tight up to constant factors.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Improves the O(log² n) bound from SODA '18 to the optimal O(log n) bound, addressing a gap in the analysis of electric flows and random walk properties on graphs.

Method: Uses transfer-current matrix techniques and symmetric matrix analysis to establish norm bounds on random edge currents.

Result: Unweighted graphs: L1 norm ≤ 2 log n for unit electric current on random edges. Weighted graphs: spectral norm of absolute symmetric transfer-current matrix ≤ 2 log n.

Conclusion: Provides optimal O(log n) bounds for both unweighted graphs (L1 norm) and weighted graphs (spectral norm), improving upon previous O(log² n) results. The 2 log n bound is proven tight up to constant factors.

Abstract: We prove that for any unweighted graph on n vertices the L1 norm of a unit electric current between the endpoints of a random edge is at most 2 log n. Furthermore, we show that on any weighted graph the spectral norm of the entry-wise absolute value of the symmetric transfer-current matrix is at most 2 log n. This bound is tight up to constants and improves the O(log^2 n) bound from [Schild-Rao-Srivastava, SODA '18]. The initial proofs were generated by OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Pro; the authors have verified and rewritten them to enhance readability and provide additional context.

</details>


### [404] [A Comprehensive Evaluation of Vertex Elimination Algorithms for Algorithmic Differentiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24280)
*Alex Crane,Pål Grønås Drange,Eli Friedman,Paul D. Hovland,Jan Hückelheim,Andrew Lyons,Yosuke Mizutani,Macéo Ottavy,Blair D. Sullivan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文把算法微分(AD)中的顶点消除序列优化问题形式化为两个NP完全问题——最优顶点消除(Optimal Vertex Elimination, OVE)与最小边数(Minimum Edge Count, MEC),并首次给出系统的、可扩展的精确求解与全面评估:设计并实现新的整数规划(ILP)建模(OVE从Θ(n⁴)约束降为Θ(n³),MEC变量从Θ(n³)降为Θ(n²)),可处理比已有方法大1~2个数量级的图(OVE最大237顶点、MEC最大1751顶点),从而组装出56张已知最优解的语料库;在语料库上系统评估了14种OVE启发式与13种MEC启发式,证实主流方法在真实数据上质量很高(OVE中每个启发式在≥82%图上达到2近似,9/14个启发式的最坏比值<2;MEC中11/13在≥81%图上取得最优)。理论上给出了前向/反向模式的紧近似保证(2|S|与2|T|,均紧)、以最小S-T分隔符规模为参数的MiddleOut算法(O(|C|²)近似)、两个问题首个近似下界(APX-难,且在有界度DAG上仍成立),并证明LP松弛积分间隙分别达Ω(n^{1/4})与Ω(n),说明简单取整方向不可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD(线性化计算图模型)的Jacobian计算可解释为DAG上的一串顶点消除,其Markowitz度μ(v)=|N⁻(v)|·|N⁺(v)|度量消元所需乘法次数,直接决定求导代价。最小代价消除序列问题(OVE)已被证明NP完全,因此学界与工业界大量依赖各类贪心/搜索启发式(如Griewank-Reese的Markowitz贪心、模拟退火、蒙特卡洛树搜索/深度强化学习等),这些启发式"在实践中表现良好"的普遍假设一直缺乏可验证证据,根本原因是缺少可扩展的精确(ILP)求解器:Chen等人的ILP建模需Θ(n⁴)约束,仅能处理约20顶点的小图,无法提供最优解基线。此外,前向/反向AD模式(即拓扑序/逆拓扑序消除)的近似质量此前缺乏严格刻画,O/Min Edge Count类问题的复杂度(除NP完全外)也几乎空白。

Method: 【问题定义】D=(V=S⊎I⊎T,E);消除内部顶点v:删v,对每个入邻居u与出邻居w加边(u,w)(若不存在),边权累乘∂v/∂u·∂w/∂v。OVE:求总消除序列最小总成本(=Markowitz度之和);MEC:求非总消除序列最小化终图边数|E(D_σ)|;另研究其对偶Maximum Edge Reduction。

【新的ILP建模】
- OVE:放弃Chen等人的"时间步"抽象,仅编码消除的相对次序。变量x_ij(i在j之前消元)给出内点上全序;e_ij标记边在过程中是否出现;z_ijk标记(i,j,k)是否构成k处的一次"乘法"。约束:传递性x_ij+x_jk≤x_ik+1;反对称x_ij=1-x_ji;初始边e_ij=1;"边一旦存在必持续到其一端被删"及"经k消元生成的(i,j)必存在且记一次乘法"的正确性约束;整数性。约束数从Θ(n⁴)降至Θ(n³)。
- MEC:关键引理(引理2.4)——对任意X⊆I,消除X中顶点的最终DAG与顺序无关,故MEC实为"顶点选择问题"而非"排序问题"。变量x_i(是否消元)、z_ij(某子集阶段存在的边)、y_ij(终图边);约束把"存在内部顶点全被消元的路径i→j"编码为线性不等式。变量降至Θ(n²),约束Θ(n³)。
- 强化:传递闭包固定不可能出现的变量;基于max-flow割的逐点下界约束cut(S,k)·cut(k,T);新引理OPT(D)≥|E|/2作为整体下界;预处理规则(Markowitz度为1的顶点可置于序列首位,ILP-VE-D穷尽使用)。
- 四个变体A/B/C/D逐级加入上述优化,并与Chen的ILP-VE/ILP-SC对比(Gurobi 13,单线程,10分钟超时)。

【理论分析】
- 引理2.2:OPT(D)≥|E|/2(归纳+ab≥(a+b)/2不等式)。
- 引理3.1:前向序成本≤|S|·|E|,反向序≤|T|·|E|;结合引理2.2得前向是2|S|近似、反向是2|T|近似(定理3.2),并给出渐近紧的构造。
- 引理3.3:任一v的内点出度×入度是OPT的下界(充电论证)。
- MiddleOut算法(算法1):给定S-T分隔符C(用max-flow求最小分隔符),将I\C分为左顶点V_L(在G_D\C中与S连通)、右顶点V_R(与T连通)与中间连通分量V_i;按"左逆拓扑序→右拓扑序→各中间分量拓扑序→C∩I拓扑序"消元;定理3.4给出O(|C|²)近似,附录进一步给出凸分隔符下O(|C|+|E(C)|)近似,凸且独立分隔符下3|C|近似(与Fw/Rev一致),并给出Ω(|C|²)紧的实例。
- 附录A.1给出两个LP松弛积分间隙下界:OVE为Ω(n^{1/4}),MEC为Ω(n)(通过大girth/双层结构构造)。
- 近似下界(第6节):OVE从cubic Vertex Cover归约,证明在最大入度7/出度6/总度9的有界度DAG上仍APX-难;先证Maximum Independent Set在最大度3、最小度2、girth≥g、无相邻度3顶点类图上APX-难(反复细分边保持近似保真);再构造含复制顶点v′与辅助集I_v、O_v的DAG,使"好解(nice solution)"恰对应独立集,得MEC与Maximum Edge Reduction在入度6/出度9/总度13上APX-难;对Maximum Edge Reduction进一步用girth-5图上MIS的近似障碍给出除非NP⊆BPP否则无多项式n^c近似的强下界。
- 新预处理规则(定理A.5):若μ_D(v)=μ*_D(v)且P⁺_D(v)⊆T、|P⁺_D(v)|≤1(或对称条件),则存在最优序列使v最先被消除。

【实验】语料库5个来源共56图:CHMU(5)、G&W(4)、NLS(26,CoDiPack抓取)、Evol(10,PDE时序演化图)、AlphaG(11,Graphax/JAX);评估Fw、Rev、Mar、rMar、MR、LMMD、DMC(本文新提出)、PL、PC、ER、MD、MO、SA、MCMC、AG等启发式的近似比、运行时间与所得最优解。

Result: 【ILP性能】10分钟内:ChenILP-VE解出14/56,本文ILP-VE各变体至少27/56,ILP-VE-D达42/56(75%);最大可解OVE图从20顶点提升到237顶点。ChenILP-SC解出13/56,ILP-SC解出52/56(93%),最大1751顶点;相对已有最快ILP的中位运行时间改进:OVE 92%、MEC 96%。

【启发式评估(OVE,47图已知最优)】14个启发式中8个在过半图上取得最优解;所有启发式在≥39/47(82%)图上达2近似,9/14个最坏比值<2。平均近似比(全体):AG 1.02、rMar 1.03、DMC 1.24、MO 1.24、Rev 1.24、LMMD 1.03、MR 1.14、Mar 1.12、PL 1.38、Fw 1.63。AG表现强但极慢(常需数小时GPU),其37个最优解中31个仅来自Fw/Rev/Mar的简单集成(该集成本身中位/75分位/最坏比1.0/1.07/1.52,与AG几乎相同);AG在395顶点图上无法求解。

【启发式评估(MEC,54图已知最优)】11/13个启发式在≥44/54(81%)图上取得最优,最坏比2.95;例外为LMMD(中位4.19,最坏30.83)与MR(中位5.04,最坏31),二者本为OVE设计,建议避免用于MEC;MCMC在除演化图外的所有图上取得最优。

【演化图(evolution graphs)】Mar表现具有误导性:无法计算大演化图的最优解,但在20×20×20(8800顶点)演化图上Mar的解为Fw的2.69倍,9点模板平面演化为2.27倍(rMar 2.14倍);Fw/Rev在演化图上表现优秀但仍缺理论解释。

【理论结论】前向=2|S|近似、反向=2|T|近似且紧;MiddleOut为O(|C|²)近似(凸分隔符下O(|C|+|E(C)|))并一般化Fw/Rev;OVE在有界度DAG上APX-难、MEC与Maximum Edge Reduction同样APX-难、Maximum Edge Reduction无多项式n^c近似(除非NP⊆BPP);LP松弛积分间隙Ω(n^{1/4})/Ω(n)。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把AD的顶点消除策略从"依赖经验信念"推进到"可度量、可验证"的阶段:(1)提供了显著更紧凑且工程上更高效的ILP建模,使精确最优解可扩展到数百至上千顶点,并据此建立首个中等规模已知最优语料库;(2)在语料库上给出迄今最全面的启发式横向评估,肯定了主流贪心/搜索方法的实用价值(绝大多数在真实数据上取得最优或近最优),同时明确指出LMMD、MR不适用于MEC,以及深度强化学习方法AG的收益有限且时间代价高;(3)理论上补齐了前向/反向模式的紧近似分析,提出以S-T分隔符为参数的MiddleOut,并给出两类问题首个近似下界(均APX-难,含有界度情形),从而界定了"不存在常数因子近似"的可能性边界。作者指出若干开放问题:受限(如有界度)情形下的LP取整方案、MiddleOut近似比的紧性、演化图上Fw/Rev的理论刻画,以及常数因子近似的存在性仍悬而未决。

Abstract: The algorithmic differentiation (AD) of mathematical functions can be interpreted as a sequence of vertex eliminations in an underlying directed acyclic graph. The problem of determining a minimum-cost elimination ordering, which we call Optimal Vertex Elimination, is NP-complete. Consequently, much effort has been devoted to the design of heuristics. Many of these heuristics are widely believed to perform well in practice, but this hypothesis has so far been difficult to test due to the lack of scalable exact methods.
  We design and engineer new integer programming formulations for Optimal Vertex Eliminatioin and for a related objective we call Minimum Edge Count. Our implementations scale to graphs one-to-two orders of magnitude larger than existing techniques, enabling the assembly of a corpus of medium-sized graphs for which optimal solutions are known. This corpus facilitates a study of existing heuristics, confirming that on real data popular methods achieve high quality solutions.
  We also make several theoretical contributions. We give a tight analysis of the forward and reverse modes of AD, and extend our techniques to provide a simple algorithm for Optimal Vertex Elimination with approximation ratio parameterized by the size of a minimum source-sink separator. On the complexity side, we give the first approximation lower bounds for both problems.

</details>


### [405] [Covering vertices by sequential stars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24711)
*Mengyuan Hu,An Zhang,Yong Chen,Zhikai Chen,Wei Ding,Guohui Lin,Jiaxuan Ma,Yue Sun*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究"序列 [k,ℓ]-星打包"问题：在图中用若干顶点不相交的星（每个星有 k~ℓ 个卫星，ℓ 可为无穷）覆盖尽可能多的顶点。当 k=1 时多项式可解，k≥2 时强 NP-困难。作者针对四个序列变体分别给出首个或改进的近似算法：k≥3 且 ℓ=∞ 时 (k+1)/2-近似（改进此前 (k+1)²/(2k+1)）；k=2 且 ℓ=∞ 时 4/3-近似（改进此前 3/2）；k=2<ℓ 时首个 (1+ℓ/(ℓ+1))-近似；3≤k<ℓ 时首个 (1+max{(k-1)/2, (k+1)ℓ/(3(ℓ+1))})-近似。此外还证明了 k=2 情形的 APX-困难（不可近似优于 2077/2076-ε）。核心方法是局部搜索 + 摊还分析，并首次提出"增广配置"来桥接两个相距较远的邻域结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星打包（star packing）是 H-打包框架下的经典问题，在无线传感器网络等领域有广泛应用。文献中"序列"一词原仅指候选星卫星数区间为 [1,ℓ] 的情形，Hell 与 Kirkpatrick 已证明 [1,∞) 与 [1,ℓ] 版本多项式可解，而使用其他候选星族（如 k≥2）的星打包则是强 NP-困难的，因此 k≥2 的 [k,ℓ]-Star Packing 缺乏有效的精确算法。此前 [k,∞)（k+-星打包）已有若干局部搜索近似算法：k=2 时最好比 3/2（Li & Lin 的 2、Huang 等的 9/5、Hu 等的 3/2），k≥3 时最好比 1+k²/(2k+1)（Hu 等）；Li 给出下界 (12k+19)/(12k+18.994)，且 k≥3 时已被证明为 APX-困难。而 [k,ℓ]（2≤k<ℓ）这类有限上界的序列变体在近似算法方向尚未被研究，文献中仅知其可归约为带权 (ℓ+1)-集合打包，从而得到 1+ℓ/2 的近似比。本文的动机即为：改进 [k,∞) 变体的既有近似比，并首次填补 [k,ℓ] 变体（k≥2）在近似算法与不可近似性两方面的空白。

Method: 统一框架：局部搜索算法（Collect 与 Trade 操作族），配合摊还式（amortized）性能分析。

1. 局部操作：Collect——在余图（remainder graph）中取度数 d≥k 的顶点连同其邻居抽取为星（[k,ℓ] 情形取 min{d,ℓ} 个卫星）；Trade-i（1≤i≤3）——移除 i 棵内部星，转而从新暴露的未覆盖顶点中（用二分图最大匹配判定）抽取 i+1 棵可行星以覆盖更多顶点；Trade-along-AC(s)——沿"增广配置"把一颗卫星"搬运"到远处另一颗星中，再执行 Trade-i。

2. 增广配置（AC）：在内部星上隐式构造有向图 ℋ（星到星的弧），用 BFS 在 O(|V|²) 内判定 AC 是否存在。k=2 且 ℓ=∞ 的 AC 由一串"最小"的 2-星组成，用于把卫星从远处 3+-星移入 2-星；2≤k<ℓ 的 AC 由一串"最大"的 ℓ-星组成，用于把远处未覆盖顶点"搬运"过来替换近处的卫星，从而创造新的局部改进机会。文中指出这是对 Edmonds 增广路径思想与 Hell–Kirkpatrick 增广结构的推广。

3. 分析技术：固定一个最优星打包 Q，为每个未覆盖顶点发一枚"token"，按规则把最优星内的 token（可分数化）转移给同一最优星中已被覆盖的顶点；定义内部星收到的 token 总数 τ(S)，证明 |V(Q)| ≤ |V(P)| + Σ_S τ(S)，再通过"重星（heavy star）"与"伴随星（companion star）"的结构性引理（如重星中心最多收 (k-2)/3 枚 token、两个重星不共享伴随星等）做摊还平均，得到每颗星平均 token 数上界，从而推出近似比。

Result: 定理1：当 k≥3、ℓ=∞ 时，算法 Approx[k,∞) 为 O(|V|^9.5) 时间的 (k+1)/2-近似算法，改进此前最优比 (k+1)²/(2k+1)。

定理2：当 k=2、ℓ=∞ 时，算法 Approx[2,∞)（含新增的 Trade-along-AC(s) 操作）为 O(|V|^15.5) 时间的 4/3-近似算法，改进此前最优比 3/2。

定理3：当 k=2<ℓ 时，算法 Approx[2,ℓ] 为 O(|V|^8.5) 时间的首个 (1+ℓ/(ℓ+1))-近似算法（优于归约得到的 1+ℓ/2）。

定理4：当 3≤k<ℓ 时，算法 Approx[k,ℓ]（允许 Trade-i, i=1,2,3 与含 Trade-2 的 AC 版本）为 O(|V|^10.5) 时间的首个 (1+max{(k-1)/2, (k+1)ℓ/(3(ℓ+1))})-近似算法。

定理5：证明了 [2,∞)-Star Packing 的 APX-困难：通过从 APX-困难的 Max3CNF-SAT-3 的保间隙归约（子三次图，|V|<33.5m、|E|≤37m），得到除非 P=NP 否则不可近似优于 2077/2076-ε（≈1.000481）。此外指出 k=ℓ 时归约为 (k+1)-集合打包，作者方法不能改进其 (k+2)/3+ε 的比值，故全文假设 k<ℓ。

Conclusion: 本文在序列星打包问题的近似算法方向取得四项首个或改进的结果：把 [k,∞) 变体的最好比从 (k+1)²/(2k+1) 降到 (k+1)/2（k≥3）、从 3/2 降到 4/3（k=2），并首次为 [k,ℓ]（2≤k<ℓ）变体给出 (1+ℓ/(ℓ+1)) 与 (1+max{(k-1)/2,(k+1)ℓ/(3(ℓ+1))}) 的近似算法；同时补齐了 k=2 情形的不可近似性证明（2077/2076-ε），使 k≥2 全部变体均被证明为 APX-困难。方法论层面的主要贡献是"局部搜索 + 摊还分析"体系，并首次引入增广配置来连接两个相距较远的局部结构，使局部改进能跨越更广的邻域。作者指出，现有上下界之间仍存在很大差距，需要引入局部搜索之外的其他算法设计技术，或构造可多项式时间计算的全局打包结构来进一步提升解的质量。

Abstract: We study the problem of covering the maximum number of vertices in a graph by a collection of vertex-disjoint stars, each with a number of satellites in a given interval $[k, \ell]$, where $1 \le k < \ell$ and $\ell$ can be infinity. This is referred to as sequential {\sc $[k, \ell]$-Star Packing} problem. It is solvable in polynomial time when $k = 1$, but becomes strongly NP-hard when $k \ge 2$. In this paper, we propose either the first or an improved approximation algorithm for the following four sequential settings: 1) a $\frac {k+1}2$-approximation algorithm when $k \ge 3$ and $\ell = \infty$, improving the previous best ratio of $\frac {(k+1)^2}{2k+1}$; 2) a $\frac 43$-approximation algorithm when $k = 2$ and $\ell = \infty$, improving the previous best ratio of $\frac 32$; 3) the first $(1 + \frac \ell{\ell+1})$-approximation algorithm when $2 = k < \ell$; and 4) the first $(1 + \max\left\{\frac {k-1}2, \frac {(k+1) \ell}{3 (\ell+1)}\right\})$-approximation algorithm when $3 \le k < \ell$. Besides the main algorithmic techniques being local search coupled with amortized analysis, we observe augmenting configurations to bridge two distant neighborhoods for a local improvement operation. Additionally, the problem has been shown APX-hard when $k \ge 3$; we prove its APX-hardness for the last remaining case where $k = 2$.

</details>


### [406] [Approximation algorithms for the prize-collecting rural postman problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24944)
*Hong Li,Jianping Li,Wei Li,Runtao Xie,Xiaoxiao Yang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 论文研究了 prize-collecting rural postman problem (PCRPP)，证明了将PCRPP转换为PCTSP求解的方法存在两倍障碍，提出了一个近似比小于1.6的多项式时间近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的PCRPP近似算法设计思路是将问题转换为 prize-collecting traveling salesman problem (PCTSP) 实例，然后求解PCTSP并转换回PCRPP解。然而论文证明了这种方法存在内在的两倍障碍：即使PCTSP实例被精确求解，转换得到的PCRPP解的目标值也可能任意接近原始PCRPP最优值的两倍。

Method: 论文提出了一种直接的多项式时间近似算法，而非通过PCTSP转换的方法。该算法专门针对PCRPP问题设计，绕过了传统转换方法中固有的两倍障碍。

Result: 论文的主要成果是一个多项式时间近似算法，其近似比严格小于1.6。

Conclusion: 该算法在118个基准实例上进行了测试，平均最优性差距为3.39%，最大为12.12%，表明该方法在实际应用中表现良好。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the prize-collecting rural postman problem (PCRPP), a variant of the rural postman problem. Given a PCRPP instance consisting of an undirected graph whose edges have nonnegative lengths and nonnegative profits, together with a root vertex, the goal is to find a closed walk that starts and ends at the root vertex and minimizes the sum of its length and the profits of all edges that the walk does not traverse. A natural way to design an approximation algorithm for the PCRPP is to construct a prize-collecting traveling salesman problem (PCTSP) instance from the given PCRPP instance, apply an approximation algorithm to the PCTSP instance, and then convert the resulting PCTSP solution into a PCRPP solution. We show that this approach has an inherent factor-two barrier: even if the constructed PCTSP instance is solved exactly, the resulting PCRPP solution can have objective value arbitrarily close to twice the optimum value of the original PCRPP instance. Our main result is a polynomial-time approximation algorithm with approximation ratio strictly smaller than 1.6 for the PCRPP. On a public 118-instance benchmark set, the proposed algorithm has average and maximum optimality gaps of 3.39\% and 12.12\%, respectively.

</details>


### [407] [CAFS: A Cache-Aware Frequency Sort for Low-Cardinality Integer Data on x86-64](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25040)
*Vasiliy S. Shlyk*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: CAFS是一种利用小基数特性（K << N）优化的AVX2整数排序算法，在OLAP低基数场景下比pdqsort、IPS4o、vqsort等主流排序算法快1.2-3.5倍，其有效操作范围受vqsort交叉点约束（K ≈ 6.7×10⁵）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OLAP引擎中整数排序操作的目标列基数K往往远小于数组长度N（典型于group-by后中间键列或字典编码的分类字段）。现有比较排序（Θ(N log N)）和基数排序（Θ(N·B/b)）的复杂度与K无关，未能利用这一特性造成性能浪费。

Method: CAFS算法通过三方面优化利用低基数特性：①SIMD缓存线级桶排序结构；②使用Chao1基数估计器（1024步长样本，40KB开放寻址表）预估K值；③自适应调度器配合溢出保护机制。核心热循环采用无分支设计，结合AVX2 cmpeq、movemask和tzcnt指令精确定位匹配车道。

Result: 实验覆盖N从10³至3×10⁷的58种规模、592,770次计时运行。在K << N区域，CAFS吞吐量是pdqsort的1.7-3.1倍、IPS4o的1.7-3.5倍、vqsort的1.2-2.3倍。与各基线的交叉点分别为：pdqsort约1.3×10⁵、ska_sort约8.14×10⁵、vqsort约6.7×10⁵，IPS4o仅在K接近N时才收敛。

Conclusion: CAFS的最优操作范围受vqsort交叉点约束，当K超过约6.7×10⁵时，CAFS不再具有性能优势。五个基线算法中，仅vqsort能在此交叉点后反超CAFS，这使得CAFS在K << N的小基数整数排序场景下成为目前最优选择，但在高基数场景下仍需依赖vqsort。

Abstract: Integer sorts in OLAP engines often run on columns whose cardinality $K$ is much smaller than the array length $N$. After a group-by stage the intermediate key column has $K$ bounded by the number of distinct group keys, and even a column-store scan typically operates on dictionary-encoded categorical fields where $K$ never exceeds a few thousand. A comparison sort on such a column still pays $Θ(N \log N)$ comparisons, and a radix sort still pays $Θ(N \cdot B/b)$ byte passes, irrespective of $K$. This paper describes CAFS, an integer sort that does exploit it on x86-64 with AVX2. The algorithm combines a SIMD bucket sized to one cache line, a Chao1 cardinality estimator over 1024 strided samples (kept in a heap-allocated 40 KB open-addressing table), and an adaptive dispatcher backed by a spill safety guard. The hot loop is branchless and uses AVX2 cmpeq together with movemask and tzcnt to locate the matching lane. We benchmarked CAFS on a full-factorial grid of 58 array sizes $N$ from $10^3$ to $3 \cdot 10^7$ with dense $K$ schedules per $N$, producing 592770 timed runs against pdqsort, IPS4o, vqsort, ska_sort, and std::sort. In the $K \ll N$ band the throughput is 1.7 to 3.1x that of pdqsort, 1.7 to 3.5x IPS4o, and 1.2 to 2.3x vqsort. The operational crossover against pdqsort is at $K \approx 1.3 \cdot 10^5$; against ska_sort, $K \approx 8.14 \cdot 10^5$; against vqsort, $K \approx 6.7 \cdot 10^5$; and against IPS4o the curves only converge near $K = N$. Of the five baselines, only vqsort actually overtakes CAFS once the crossover is passed, which makes the vqsort threshold at $K \approx 6.7 \cdot 10^5$ the binding constraint on the operational range of CAFS.

</details>


### [408] [The Dirichlet Mechanism for rounding with strong negative correlation, with applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25078)
*David G. Harris,George Z. Li,Nitya Raju,Renata Valieva*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: This paper introduces the Dirichlet mechanism for dependent rounding in bipartite assignment graphs, achieving stronger negative correlation with simpler implementation. Demonstrated through improved approximation ratios for two problems: 0.68 vs 0.652 for online rounding, and 1.387 vs 1.398 for job scheduling.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Standard fractional relaxation with independent rounding causes uneven loading on left-nodes, leading to suboptimal solutions for assignment graph problems.

Method: Dirichlet mechanism: each left-node draws Dirichlet random variables for its edges, then each right-node independently selects an edge based on these values, avoiding the need for tie-breaking mechanisms.

Result: New approximation ratios: 0.68-approximation for oblivious online dependent rounding (vs 0.652); 1.387-approximation for scheduling jobs on unrelated machines to minimize weighted completion time (vs 1.398).

Conclusion: The Dirichlet mechanism achieves stronger negative correlation with simpler implementation, demonstrated through improved approximation ratios for oblivious online dependent rounding (0.68) and job scheduling on unrelated machines (1.387).

Abstract: Many optimization and scheduling problems can be abstracted in terms of a bipartite ``assignment graph" $G = (L \cup R, E)$, where the goal is to select exactly one edge for each right-node. For example, a right-node may correspond to a job, and a left-node to a possible machine assignment. A common strategy to solve such problems is to obtain a fractional relaxation $x_e$ for each edge $e$, and then have each right-node independently select an edge with probability $x_e$. However, this may cause the left-nodes to become unevenly loaded, leading to suboptimal solutions for some problems.
  To address this, a number of algorithms for dependent rounding with strong negative correlation have been developed, e.g. Bansal, Srinivasan & Svensson (2021), Im & Shadloo (2020), Im & Li (2023), Harris (2024), Naor, Srinivasan & Wajc (2025). We introduce a new method for this, which we call the \emph{Dirichlet mechanism}. It is based on having each left-node draw Dirichlet random variables for its edges, and then having each right-node select an edge based on these values. This achieves quantitatively stronger negative correlation than previous algorithms, and is also simpler since it avoids the need for a tie-breaking mechanism.
  We illustrate the mechanism with improved approximation ratios for two problems. For oblivious online dependent rounding, we achieve a $0.68$-approximation which improves upon the previous $0.652$-approximation of Naor, Srinivasan & Wajc (2025). For the problem of scheduling jobs on unrelated machines to minimize weighted completion time, we achieve a $1.387$-approximation which improves upon the $1.398$-approximation of Harris (2024). (A recent algorithm of Li (2025) based on iterated rounding also provides a $1.36$-approximation if the weights of each job are independent of machine.)

</details>


### [409] [Approximate Algorithms for Chamfer Distance Under Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25280)
*Gil Halevi,Daniel Zhang,Jason Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 论文提出Chamfer距离在平移下的极小化问题(CDuT)，即通过平移点集A来最小化其到B的Chamfer距离。文章设计了四种算法：精确二次时间算法(1D)、近二次时间2近似、高维多项式时间1近似，以及分离假设下的近二次时间1近似决策算法，并给出了细粒度复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chamfer距离在计算机视觉和信息检索中广泛用作Earth Mover's距离的替代方案，但现有研究未考虑平移不变性。当平移携带不相关的时间、空间或语义信息时，需要对点集A进行最优平移以消除其影响。

Method: 设计了四种算法：(1)一维精确二次时间算法，(2)高维近二次时间(2+ε)近似算法，(3)运行时间O(mn²ε^(-(d+1)))的(1+ε)近似算法，(4)分离假设下近二次时间(1+ε)近似决策算法。

Result: 给出了CDuT的多层次近似算法谱系，并建立了细粒度复杂度下界，证明了不同近似因子与时间复杂度之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 提出了CDuT这一新问题，给出了从精确算法到近似算法的多种解决方案，并建立了细粒度复杂度下界，为该领域后续研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Given two sets of points A and B, $|A| = m$, $|B| = n$, the Chamfer distance from $A$ to $B$ is defined as $\operatorname{CD}(A,B) = \sum_{a\in A} \min_{b\in B} d(a,b)$, where $d$ is a distance metric. Chamfer distance is a popular measure of dissimilarity between two sets of points that has seen increasing usage in computer vision and information retrieval as a substitute for the more computationally demanding Earth Mover's distance. We propose a new problem, Chamfer distance under translation, defined as $\operatorname{CDuT}(A,B) :=\min_{t\in \mathbb{R}^d} \operatorname{CD}(A+t,B)$, where $A+t$ denotes the translation of every point in $A$ by $t$. Chamfer distance under translation is valuable in cases where translations capture aspects of the data unlikely to be relevant for dissimilarity, such as temporal, spatial, or other semantic information. For Chamfer distance under translation, we provide four algorithms: (1) an exact quadratic time algorithm in one dimension, (2) a near quadratic time ($2+\varepsilon$)-approximation algorithm in higher dimensions, (3) a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm with running time $\mathcal{O}(mn^2\varepsilon^{-(d+1)})$, and (4) a near-quadratic time $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for answering the decision version of $\operatorname{CDuT}$ given a separation assumption on $B$. We additionally explore the fine-grained complexity of $\operatorname{CDuT}$.

</details>


### [410] [Algorithms with Polynomially-Improved Approximation Factors for the $2 \rightarrow q$ Norm, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25303)
*Samuel B. Hopkins,Stefan Tiegel*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文研究了矩阵X的2→q范数近似问题，给出q>2时首个超越简单谱基线(d^(1/4))的多项式时间乘法近似算法，对q=4达d^(1/8)近似，并构造了SoS证书用于鲁棒统计估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2→q范数问题与组合优化中的Small Set Expansion、量子信息中的Best Separable State等问题密切相关近似因子对下游应用有重要影响此前仅知d^(1/4)-近似基线且算法需额外假设

Method: 设计多项式时间乘法近似算法，针对q>2的超压缩情形。构建2→q范数的平方和(SoS)证书。

Result: 首次在多项式时间内超越d^(1/4)基线；q=4时实现d^(1/8)-近似；构造SoS证书并导出鲁棒估计等应用的有效算法

Conclusion: 该工作首次在多项式时间内实现超越d^(1/4)基线的多项式因子改进，对q=4特殊情况达到d^(1/8)近似。进一步，SoS证明器直接应用于鲁棒均值/协方差估计、鲁棒回归和聚类等任务。

Abstract: The $2 \rightarrow q$ norm of a matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ is defined as $\lVert X \rVert_{2 \rightarrow q} = \sup_{\lVert v \rVert_2 = 1} \lVert Xv \rVert_q$. We give polynomial-time multiplicative approximation algorithms for this norm when $q > 2$ (i.e. in the hypercontractive setting). This problem either directly captures or is closely related to long-standing open problems in combinatorial optimization and hardness of approximation (e.g. Small Set Expansion), quantum information (e.g. Best Separable State), and algorithmic statistics.
  Very little is known about what approximation factors we can achieve for this problem in polynomial time, even though such approximations have significant downstream consequences. Barak, Brandão, Harrow, Kelner, Steurer, and Zhou showed that no polynomial-time algorithm can achieve an approximation factor better than $2^{\sqrt{\log n}}$, assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis (FOCS'12). On the other hand, a simple spectral algorithm gives a $d^{1/4}$-approximation as a baseline. We give, to the best of our knowledge, the first polynomial-time approximation algorithm beating this baseline by polynomial factors. For the important special case of $q = 4$ it achieves a $d^{1/8}$-approximation. All previous algorithms required additional assumptions on $X$, or only surpassed the baseline for small values of $n$.
  Moreover, we construct sum-of-squares certificates for the $2 \rightarrow q$ norm. This directly implies improved algorithms for robust mean and covariance estimation, robust regression, and clustering, when the data only satisfies a bound on its $q$-th moment.

</details>


### [411] [A Note on Approximability of Densest At-Least-k-Subgraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25464)
*Bundit Laekhanukit,Pasin Manurangsi,Ohad Trabelsi*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The paper provides hardness of approximation results for Densest At-Least-$k$-Subgraph (DAL$k$S): (3/2 - ε)-factor hardness via simple reduction from D$k$S, tighter (2 - ε)-factor hardness under stronger assumptions, and W[1]-hardness for the exact version — all in both normal and parameterized settings, reducing reliance on SSEH.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The DAL$k$S problem is a natural generalization of D$k$S, with existing 2-approximation algorithms. The motivation is to establish hardness of approximation results without relying solely on the Small Set Expansion Hypothesis (SSEH), particularly to extend results to the parameterized setting where previous hardness did not apply.

Method: Simple reduction from D$k$S to DAL$k$S in both normal and parameterized settings. The reduction involves adding universal vertices and constructing auxiliary graphs to transform D$k$S instances into DAL$k$S instances, enabling hardness-of-approximation transfers.

Result: Under constant-factor hardness of D$k$S, DAL$k$S is hard to approximate within $(3/2 - \varepsilon)$. Under stronger $k^{1-\delta}$-factor hardness of D$k$S, DAL$k$S is hard within $(2 - \varepsilon)$. The exact version of DAL$k$S is W[1]-hard parameterized by $k$.

Conclusion: The hardness reduction shows that DAL$k$S inherits inapproximability from D$k$S, and the exact version is W[1]-hard. The main contributions are: (1) A simple reduction showing $(3/2 - \varepsilon)$-factor hardness under constant-factor hardness of D$k$S; (2) A tighter $(2 - \varepsilon)$-factor hardness under stronger $k^{1-\delta}$-factor hardness assumption; (3) W[1]-hardness for exact DAL$k$S. These results weaken the dependency on SSEH, especially for parameterized settings.

Abstract: We study the Densest At-Least-$k$-Subgraph (DAL$k$S) problem, in which we are given an undirected graph $G$ and an integer $k$, and the goal is to find a subgraph of $G$ with at least $k$ vertices with maximum density. The best-known algorithm, independently discovered by Khuller and Saha (2009) and by Andersen (2007), yields a 2-approximation for DAL$k$S in polynomial time.
  In this note, we provide a (simple) reduction from Densest $k$-Subgraph (D$k$S) to Densest At-Least-$k$-Subgraph, which shows that, if D$k$S is hard to approximate to within any constant factor, then DAL$k$S is hard to approximate to within $(3/2 - \varepsilon)$ factor for every $\varepsilon > 0$. This holds in both the normal (non-parameterized) and the parameterized (by $k$) settings.
  We then generalize the reduction to provide a tight $(2 - \varepsilon)$ factor hardness of approximating Densest At-Least-$k$-Subgraph, albeit under a stronger hypothesis which roughly states that Densest $k$-Subgraph is hard to approximate to within $k^{1 - δ}$ factor for any constant $δ> 0$. Once again, this extends naturally to the parameterized setting. Previously, $(2 - \varepsilon)$ factor inapproximability for DAL$k$S was only known under the Small Set Expansion Hypothesis (Bergner, 2013; Manurangsi, 2017), which does not apply to the parameterized version of the problem.
  Furthermore, we show that the exact version of DAL$k$S is W[1]-hard (parameterized by $k$).

</details>


### [412] [Engineering Practical Succinct Bit Vectors: A Space-Time Pareto Analysis on Apple Silicon ARM64 Cores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25528)
*Ishant Garg*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文在Apple Silicon ARM架构上评估了三种位向量压缩结构的rank和select查询性能，发现非对称块设计可提升rank查询1.4倍，而RRR编码在极端密度下因偏移消除机制表现更优，选择查询通过超级块采样索引实现4.9倍加速。所有实现通过78百万次测试验证正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: succinct数据结构的理论与实践存在差距，需要在真实的ARM架构处理器上评估rank和select查询的实际性能表现。

Method: 对比评估三种位向量压缩结构：两级块基线(BlockBitVec)、非对称超级块实现(FastBitVec)、基于RRR编码的熵压缩表示(RRRBitVec)；在Apple Silicon M系列ARM架构上进行性能测试；针对RRRBitVec的密度依赖性行为进行实证分析。

Result: 非对称4096/256位块边界使rank查询加速1.4倍，索引开销仅7.8%；RRRBitVec呈现对称的密度依赖性钟形曲线延迟分布，极端密度(1%和99%)因边界类偏移消除而快39%；RRRBitVec的选择查询比经典二分搜索基线快4.9倍，统一密度下仅需33.7ns。

Conclusion: 三种实现的性能差距显著，RRRBitVec通过超级块采样索引将选择操作加速4.9倍且延迟降至33.7ns；非对称块设计使rank查询在ARM架构上获得1.4倍加速；极端密度下RRR编码的偏移消除机制可带来39%的性能提升。所有实现通过78百万次模糊测试验证了正确性。

Abstract: Succinct data structures use space close to the information-theoretic minimum while answering queries directly on the compressed representation. In this paper, we present a practical engineering study of rank and select queries on bit vectors. We evaluate a classic two-level block baseline (BlockBitVec), an asymmetric superblock implementation (FastBitVec), and an entropy-compressed representation (RRRBitVec) based on the Raman, Raman, and Rao (RRR) coding scheme. On Apple Silicon (M-series ARM architecture), we demonstrate a 1.4x speedup in rank queries through asymmetric 4096/256-bit block boundaries, with a rank index overhead of 7.8%. We investigate the empirical behavior of RRRBitVec and observe a symmetric density-dependent bell-curve for rank latency -- where queries at extreme densities (1% and 99%) run up to 39% faster due to offset elimination at boundary classes. We further show that RRRBitVec achieves a 4.9x speedup over classic binary-search select baselines, running in 33.7 ns at uniform density by using a superblock-level sampling index that restricts sequential scans to L1-cache lookups. All implementations are validated against a correctness fuzzer executing over 78 million assertions with no failures. Source code and test harnesses are publicly available.

</details>


### [413] [Weighted Clique and Independent Set in Edge-Distant Hereditary Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25724)
*Eshwar Srinivasan,Ramesh Hariharasubramanian*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究了两类扩展遗传图类的算法性质：edge-apex类和edge-add类。通过引入G-edge距离概念，实现了WMCP和WMISP的O*(2^k)参数化算法，并将结果推广到k-edge-distant图类和传递图类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Investigate algorithmic aspects of edge-apex and edge-add classes, which are natural extensions of hereditary classes defined by at most one edge deletion or non-edge addition from a hereditary class.

Method: Introduced the notion of G-edge distance (ξ_G(G)) quantifying minimum edge deletions/non-edge additions needed. Provided O*(2^k) parameterized algorithms for both problems based on this distance.

Result: Algorithms for WMCP and WMISP on both edge-apex and edge-add classes, as well as parameterized algorithms (O*(2^k) time) for k-edge-distant graphs.

Conclusion: The framework extends to graphs with transitive-edge distance k, where WMCP and WMISP can also be solved in O*(2^k) time.

Abstract: In this work, we investigate the algorithmic aspects of two natural extensions of hereditary classes: the edge-apex class and the edge-add class, recently introduced by Singh and Sivaraman. These are defined as the graph classes obtained by at most one edge deletion or one non-edge addition, respectively, from a hereditary class $\mathcal{G}$. Building on earlier results showing that both classes remain hereditary and admit finite forbidden induced subgraph characterizations whenever $\mathcal{G}$ does, we focus on the Weighted Maximum Clique Problem (WMCP) and the Weighted Maximum Independent Set Problem (WMISP).
  We first present algorithms for WMCP and WMISP on both the edge-apex and edge-add classes of hereditary graph classes. Extending this framework, we introduce the notion of the $\mathcal{G}$-edge distance of a graph $G$, denoted by $ξ_{\mathcal{G}}(G)$, which quantifies how far $G$ is from the class $\mathcal{G}$ in terms of the minimum number of edge deletions or non-edge additions needed to transform it into a member of $\mathcal{G}$.
  By parameterizing with respect to this distance, we show that both WMCP and WMISP can be solved in $O^*(2^k)$ time on graphs whose $\mathcal{G}$-edge distance is $k$, provided these problems admit polynomial-time algorithms within the class $\mathcal{G}$. This result extends earlier algorithmic characterizations of the single edge-apex and edge-add classes to the more general setting of $k$-edge-distant graphs. By combining our general results with known properties of transitive graphs, we show that WMCP and WMISP can be solved in $O^*(2^k)$ time for graphs with transitive-edge distance $k$.

</details>


### [414] [On the Complexity of Bilevel Independent Set Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25927)
*Komal Muluk*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究"分割物品"（partitioned-items）双层优化框架下的双层独立集问题（BIS）及其特例双层区间选择问题（BISel），共8个变体（领导者目标为sum/bottleneck × 跟随者目标为sum/bottleneck × 跟随者乐观/悲观反应）。结论：BISel的(c_s,d_s,o/p)变体存在O(n⁴log n)动态规划算法；BIS在一般图上从P、NP-完全到Σ₂ᵖ-完全，在二部图上难度普遍下降一级（除(c_b,d_b,p)保持NP-完全外），全部8个变体在两类图上的复杂度均被完全刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双层优化（bilevel optimization）自von Stackelberg双寡头模型（1930）以来发展迅速，Jeroslow（1985）已证明连续双层线性规划为NP-难、整数双层线性规划为Σ₂ᵖ-难。近几年 partitioned-items 形式下的双层 Selection、Assignment、Knapsack、Spanning Tree、Shortest Path 等问题已被系统研究（Henke & Wulf对Bilevel Shortest Path完成了多面体层级的完全分类）。然而，作为组合优化基本问题之一的 Independent Set 及其区间图特例 Interval Selection 的双层版本仍缺乏完整的复杂度刻画。本文动机在于：结合"领导者目标类型（sum/bottleneck）× 跟随者目标类型（sum/bottleneck）× 跟随者反应模式（乐观/悲观）"这三个二元选择产生的8个变体，系统地把双层独立集问题归类到多项式层级的相应层级；同时利用区间图上单层 Independent Set 的动态规划可解性，期望证明双层区间选择（BISel）在sum类型下仍可在多项式时间内求解，从而揭示"底层问题易解 ⇒ 双层问题未必易解"的分界点（一般图上sum类型直接跳到Σ₂ᵖ-完全）。

Method: 形式化：地面集E=E_ℓ ⊎ E_f被划分给领导者和跟随者；领导者先选 L⊆E_ℓ，跟随者在内嵌问题中优化自己的目标（乐观时在最优反应中选对领导者最有利者，悲观时选最不利者），要求 L∪F∈ℱ。目标函数分sum型 c_s(S)=Σw_ℓ(v)、d_s(S)=Σw_f(v)与bottleneck型 c_b(S)=min w_ℓ(v)、d_b(S)=min w_f(v)，并要求L∪F≠∅（否则bottleneck下空集的min=∞会退化）。关键技术：①用权重扰动 w_f(v)←w_f(v)±ε·w_ℓ(v)（ε极小）编码跟随者的乐观/悲观反应，使其argmax不变而在多解时按领导者利益打破平局；②BISel：对区间按右端点排序，定义p(k)为最后一个在i_k之前结束的区间，构造递推 opt[k]——若i_k∈I_ℓ 则 opt[k]=max{w_ℓ(i_k)+opt[p(k)], opt[k−1]}；若i_k∈I_f 则枚举领导者的"最后一个区间"j<k，opt[k]=max_j{opt[p(j)]+w_ℓ(i_j)+Σ_{i∈Sol(I_f^{j,k},w_f)}w_ℓ(i)}，其中Sol用Frank(1976)的单层Interval Selection动态规划作为子程序；③BIS一般图：(c_s/c_b,d_s,o/p) 从Σ₂ᵖ-完全的B₂^CNF归约——每个变量造互补顶点对{a_i,ā_i}（领导者侧）/ {b_i,b̄_i}（跟随者侧），每个子句造团{c_i¹,c_i²,c_i³,c_i}，文字对应的补顶点相连，再加顶点z与所有c_i相连；权重 M≫R≫max{n₁,n₂}，靠"z是否被跟随者选中"编码子句是否可满足；(c_b,d_b,p) 从Vertex Cover归约（每顶点k个副本构成团、每边一个跟随者顶点）；(c_s,d_b,o/p) 从Independent Set平凡归约（V_f=∅）；④BIS二部图：(c_s,d_s,o/p) 从planar vertex cover归约且保持平面性（细分边+挂叶子）；(c_b,d_s,o/p)与(c_b,d_b,p) 将前述归约中的每条边细分（插入(v^i)'与(u^iv^i)')以消除奇圈得到二部图；含于NP的证明分别用领导者的证书或(L,F)证书并验证跟随者最优反应。

Result: （1）BISel的(c_s,d_s,o)与(c_s,d_s,p)变体由上述动态规划在O(n⁴log n)时间内求解（区间排序与p(j)计算各O(n log n)，O(n²)对区间的Sol计算各O(n²log n)，递推O(n²)），且证明跟随者最优反应本身可在多项式时间内计算（Lemma 3.2/3.3）。（2）BIS在一般简单无向图上：(c_s/c_b,d_s,o/p)为Σ₂ᵖ-完全（既证 hardness 也证属于Σ₂ᵪ：可写成∃L,F ∀F′ 的形式）；(c_b,d_b,p)为NP-完全；(c_s,d_b,o/p)为NP-完全；(c_b,d_b,o)为P（多解时跟随者选择空集最优，领导者只需在argmax w_ℓ的顶点与空动作之间二选一）。（3）BIS在二部图上：(c_s,d_s,o/p)为NP-完全（在平面二部图上依然成立）；(c_s,d_b,o)与(c_s,d_b,p)为P（前者给出枚举阈值顶点v*并求诱导子图最大权独立集的Algorithm 1，后者领导者只需在空动作与V_ℓ中最大权独立集间选择）；(c_b,d_s,o/p)与(c_b,d_b,p)为NP-完整；(c_b,d_b,o)由一般图P结果继承为P。整体上从一般图到二部图，多数变体难度恰好下降一个层级，唯独(c_b,d_b,p)不降。

Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了分割物品型双层独立集问题在一般图与二部图上全部8个变体的复杂度层级（P、NP-完全、Σ₂ᵖ-完全），并证明双层区间选择在sum型目标下仍可多项式求解（O(n⁴log n)）。技术要点是用极小权重扰动统一编码乐观/悲观反应，以及"区间图动态规划 + 单层ISel作为子程序"的结构分解。作者指出未来方向：(i) BISel中其余6个变体（涉及bottleneck目标）的复杂度仍待确定；(ii) 现有若干可解性算法依赖对领导者动作与跟随者反应的穷举，希望设计利用问题结构的更高效算法；(iii) 可拓展到领导者与跟随者变量集不相交的（非分割物品）双层模型。

Abstract: We consider a bilevel optimization problem in which the ground set is partitioned between two decision makers, a leader and a follower, whose optimization problems are interleaved. We study the Bilevel Independent Set problem, and its special case, the Bilevel Interval Selection problem, on different variants emerging from a combination of the type of leader's objective function, the type of follower's objective function, and the setting in which the follower reacts, i.e., either optimistically or pessimistically. Here we consider sum and bottleneck type objective functions. We investigate the computational complexity of all these variants for the Bilevel Independent Set problem, and sort them into their respective level of the polynomial hierarchy. Our results range from $\mathsf{P}$, $\mathsf{NP}$-completeness to $Σ_2^\mathsf{p}$-completeness. For the Bilevel Interval Selection problem, we give a dynamic programming algorithm running in time $\mathcal{O}(n^4\log n)$ for the variants in which the leader and the follower have objective functions of the sum type.

</details>
